description.en: Recall and consolidate project memory with handoff ledgers, planning notes and context tracking.
description.zh: 整理和检索项目记忆，保存交接记录、计划笔记与上下文状态。

description.en: Save completed conversations as Markdown memories and provide retrieval and long-term memory consolidation.
description.zh: 将完成的对话保存为 Markdown 记忆，提供检索和长期记忆整理。

description.en: Run single-turn or continuing questions in an independent subagent and display the results in the current conversation.
description.zh: 在独立子 Agent 中进行单轮或连续问答，并把结果展示在当前对话中。

description.en: Consult TypeSafe Jev before a turn to suggest whether a registered agent should handle the task.
description.zh: 在模型开始处理前，通过 TypeSafe Jev 建议是否交给已注册的 Agent 执行。

description.en: dsh plugin: an unattended approval gate. Subagent, scheduled and cron approval requests get a bounded answer window, then settle on a fail-closed default instead of hanging.
description.zh: 为无人值守的子 Agent 和定时任务设置审批等待时限，超时后默认不放行。

description.en: dsh plugin: routes ask-user questions to every interaction surface bound to the asking session (TUI panel, Feishu card, web, ...), and the first answer wins.
description.zh: 将会话提问同步到终端、飞书卡片或网页等界面，采用最先收到的回答。

description.en: Deliver bounded tasks to online agents using calendar or interval schedules.
description.zh: 按日历或间隔规则，将范围明确的任务派发给在线 Agent。

description.en: Deterministic context-pruning compaction backend for dsh: zero-LLM summaries, /dcp command, works out of the box. Design references Opencode-DCP.
description.zh: 按规则裁剪和压缩上下文，无需模型生成摘要，可通过 /dcp 调用。

description.en: dsh plugin: drive an existing dsh session from Feishu/Lark, with round cards, interactive resume, ask-user cards and steer (outbound-only WebSocket bot).
description.zh: 从飞书操作已有 DSH 会话，通过卡片查看轮次、回答问题、恢复任务或补充指令。

description.en: Apply bounded retries to transient gateway failures such as EOF, TLS alerts and stream read errors.
description.zh: 对 EOF、TLS 告警和流读取失败等临时网关错误进行限次重试。

description.en: Use environment proxies and an undici dispatcher to route model traffic through configured proxies.
description.zh: 通过环境变量和 undici 为模型请求配置代理与分流。

description.en: dsh plugin: persistent whole-machine LLM usage ledger with a markdown /llm-stats report (GFM tables and emoji: tokens, cache hit, model/tool time, per-day bars).
description.zh: 记录本机各模型的用量、缓存命中和执行耗时，通过 /llm-stats 查看统计报告。

description.en: dsh plugin: token-efficient prompt-side shim for the official MCP client that folds mcp__* tool schemas out of every assembled prompt and exposes two constant meta-tools (starting with mcp_list).
description.zh: 按需检索和加载 MCP 工具，减少每次提示词中重复携带的工具定义。

description.en: dsh plugin: keeps llm-pi-ai provider routes' model lists in step with the pi.dev gateway, written through the official settings seam.
description.zh: 同步 pi.dev 网关模型列表，通过 DSH 设置更新 llm-pi-ai 供应商配置。

description.en: dsh plugin: switches named model profiles (default model, think level, per-subagent models) interactively through the host ask-user flow, one implementation for both TUI and web surfaces.
description.zh: 交互式切换模型配置，包括默认模型、思考强度和各子 Agent 模型，支持终端与网页界面。

description.en: dsh plugin: registers custom agents defined in ~/.dsh/agents/*.md as callable subagents via the use_agent tool, with continuable background dispatch and ask_agent follow-ups.
description.zh: 将本地 Markdown 文件定义的 Agent 注册为可调用子 Agent，支持后台任务续接和追问。

description.en: Quality-first topic memory for DSH. Each topic keeps its starting question, conclusion, impact, and dependencies, not the process, in a local, git-traced OKF bundle with budgeted, LLM-free injection.
description.zh: 按主题保存问题、结论、影响和依赖，用本地 Git 跟踪版本，并在预算范围内注入相关记忆。

description.en: A fully featured pi-style terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): history look-back and fork-at-turn, guided preset switching, live subagent steering, model profiles and themes.
description.zh: 提供 pi 风格终端界面，支持历史回看、从指定轮次创建分支、预设切换和子 Agent 实时引导。

description.en: dsh plugin: encrypted backup, restore and migration of the dsh home config through a private GitHub repo.
description.zh: 通过私有 GitHub 仓库加密备份、恢复和迁移 DSH 配置。

description.en: AnySearch web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页搜索接入 AnySearch。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页搜索接入 Tavily。

description.en: Add timeline navigation, folders, prompts, export, Mermaid, quoted replies, appearance controls and usage displays.
description.zh: 提供时间线、文件夹、提示词、导出、Mermaid、引用回复、外观设置和用量显示。

description.en: Record model token usage and estimated costs, then query historical statistics from Settings.
description.zh: 记录模型 Token 用量和费用估算，在设置页查询历史统计。

description.en: Accessibility-first macOS Computer Use capability for DeepSeek Harness with stale-observation protection, app leases, confirmations, screenshots, and Web diagnostics
description.zh: 通过辅助功能、截图与应用控制工具操作 macOS 桌面。

description.en: Turn-level conversation and workspace rewind for DeepSeek Harness, powered by a persistent Change Ledger
description.zh: 基于持久变更账本回退会话轮次和工作区文件。

description.en: Use image questions, OCR, grounding, UI reconstruction and pixel comparisons in DSH.
description.zh: 提供图片问答、文字识别、目标定位、界面还原和像素比较工具。

description.en: Connect AnySearch web search, page fetching and advanced search tools to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 AnySearch 网页搜索、正文抓取与高级检索工具。

description.en: Literature search for DeepSeek Harness using the official PubMed NCBI E-utilities API (esearch, esummary, efetch, elink) and Google Scholar via SerpApi or direct HTML parsing.
description.zh: 通过 PubMed 官方 API 和 Google Scholar 检索文献，后者可用 SerpApi 或网页解析。

description.en: Add a reasoning-effort slider with an animated runner to the native model selector, using each model's own levels.
description.zh: 在原生模型选择器中加入带跑步动画的推理强度滑块，档位取自各模型自身的定义。

description.en: Zoom individual web panels with Ctrl+wheel or keyboard shortcuts and reset each panel independently.
description.zh: 通过 Ctrl 加滚轮或快捷键独立缩放网页面板，并分别恢复默认大小。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for local coding agents — one group, one conversation, one pinned runtime. Bridges dsh, CLI agents (traex/codex), an IDE window, or a custom agent behind one gateway.
description.zh: 通过飞书群组连接本机 DSH、编程命令行或 IDE 助手。

description.en: Authorize FlowUs through browser OAuth and expose its official MCP tools as native agent tools.
description.zh: 通过浏览器 OAuth 授权 FlowUs，把官方 MCP 工具接为 Agent 原生工具。

description.en: Local WebSocket bridge between dsh and the DSH Browser Control browser extension, with model-facing browser_* tools and a Settings-managed on/off switch
description.zh: 连接浏览器扩展，向 Agent 提供网页操作工具与开关。

description.en: DSH Web selection-annotation plugin: select assistant text, annotate (optional), and press Enter to send the annotation block with your message — the model replies to each annotation by number, with hoverable chips in the reply.
description.zh: 选择助手回复中的文字并添加批注，让模型按编号逐条回应。

description.en: Render interactive charts, forms, diagrams and other UI inside assistant replies.
description.zh: 在助手回复中呈现交互图表、表单、流程图等界面。

description.en: Manage CloudBase databases, storage, authentication and application deployment from DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 CloudBase 数据库、存储、身份认证与应用部署。

description.en: Runs the official creator skills for general, REST API and Huawei Cloud skills from a sidebar form, shows their progress live, scores the result out of 10 and sends it back for revision until it passes.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按通用、标准 API 管理和华为云基础云服务三类填写需求，调用官方 creator 技能生成技能并实时展示过程，按 10 分制评分，未达标打回修改。

description.en: Search anime sources, inspect details and access playback links inside a conversation.
description.zh: 在会话中搜索动画来源、查看详情并使用播放入口。

description.en: Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness, where the model writes the interface in DIL (Markdown, JSX-like tags, JavaScript). The host compiles it, and a sandboxed runtime renders interactive text and rich cards.
description.zh: 将模型编写的 DIL 界面编译为交互文字和卡片，在沙箱中运行。

description.en: A persistent agent team for long-running collaboration in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为长期任务保存 Agent 团队与协作状态。

description.en: DSH plugin: inventories your Windows dev/test toolchain, spots the gaps, and fills them with one click.
description.zh: 检查 Windows 开发和测试工具链，找出并补齐缺失组件。

description.en: Ark models, web-search tools and Web UI in one bundle
description.zh: 在一个插件包中接入方舟模型、网页搜索和配套界面。

description.en: OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness: live gateway catalog, per-conversation session header, and usage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 OpenCode Go，读取网关模型目录，显示会话信息和用量。

description.en: Unified capability management for the DeepSeek Harness: catalog (ctx.capability) + meta_search/meta_invoke + Resident/On-demand/Disabled projection policy + 能力菜单 settings tab, in one installable bundle (server + browser).
description.zh: 统一管理工具等能力，支持按需查找、调用，以及常驻、按需加载和停用设置。

description.en: Create and modify Blender scenes, import models, and preview or export images and video.
description.zh: 创建和修改 Blender 场景、导入模型，并预览或导出图片与视频。

description.en: Manage agents, sessions and tools through an interactive terminal interface.
description.zh: 通过交互终端界面管理 Agent、会话和工具。

description.en: Hands your DeepSeek account balance to a whale-maid desktop pet floating on Windows. The host polls the balance and serves it over a 127.0.0.1 loopback route; pet_balance and pet_control tools let the agent read the balance or make the pet talk.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面显示鲸鱼女仆桌宠，通过本机接口查看 DeepSeek 余额，也可让 Agent 控制桌宠说话。

description.en: Combine a calendar, hierarchical tasks, AI planning, execution reviews and desktop reminders.
description.zh: 组合日历、分层任务、AI 拆解、执行复盘与桌面提醒。

description.en: Browse, preview, apply and revert color themes in DSH, including a palette matched to the default DSH colors. Sends limited usage events.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中浏览、预览、应用和还原配色主题，包含与 DSH 默认配色一致的方案。会发送有限的使用统计。

description.en: Install eight DFY plugins at once: wallpaper, appearance, archive management, media, image generation, interactive visuals, task guard and Codex connection, each with its own switch.
description.zh: 一次安装 DFY 的 8 个插件：壁纸、外观、归档管理、媒体内容、图像生成、交互可视化、任务守卫和 Codex 连接，可分别启停。

description.en: A local-first consultation skill on traditional Chinese culture, with BaZi, Zi Wei, Liu Yao, feng shui and more computed by a local engine. For cultural reference, not prediction.
description.zh: 本地优先的中国传统文化咨询技能，八字、紫微、六爻、风水等由本地引擎计算，分层给出事实、文化解释和现实建议。仅供传统文化参考，不作预测。

description.en: Generate and edit images through configurable provider channels in the web interface.
description.zh: 在网页界面配置供应商通道，生成或编辑图片。

description.en: Official DingTalk connector for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 通过钉钉连接 DSH 会话与消息。

description.en: Session-state notification plugin for the dsh web GUI: session completed/failed, question-asked, and permission-requested alerts with configurable built-in or custom sounds and browser notifications, plus a Notifications settings section
description.zh: 为会话完成、失败、提问和权限请求配置声音与浏览器通知。

description.en: Keep the flagship model in the conversation and let it dispatch scoped tasks to cheaper executor models you configure, then collect and review their reports. Pair with dsh-conductor-ui for the task board.
description.zh: 让主力模型留在对话中，把范围明确的任务分派给你配置的低成本执行模型，再收集并审阅报告。任务看板需搭配 dsh-conductor-ui。

description.en: Web task board for Conductor in the right sidebar and a full page: executor and publisher roles, follow-ups, cancellation and per-session filtering. Requires @dippingorange/dsh-conductor.
description.zh: Conductor 的网页任务看板，提供右侧栏标签页和完整页面，支持执行者与发布者角色、追问、取消和按会话筛选。需先安装 @dippingorange/dsh-conductor。

description.en: Connect Qoder models with PAT credentials, regional account pools, check-ins, automatic rotation and credit display.
description.zh: 通过 PAT 接入 Qoder 模型，支持分区域账号池、签到、自动换号和积分显示。

description.en: NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar page with in-app playback, QR sign-in, and agent tools that curate the queue.
description.zh: 在侧栏播放网易云音乐，支持扫码登录和由 Agent 整理播放队列。

description.en: The state service of DSH Agentic Roleplay: one SQLite database per session, used by other plugins. Most users should install the complete @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all instead.
description.zh: DSH Agentic Roleplay 的状态服务，每个会话一个 SQLite 数据库，供其他插件调用。一般用户建议安装完整的 @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all。

description.en: Provide reranking through Jina- or Cohere-compatible /rerank APIs for plugins that use the shared dsh-ai-providers service. It does nothing on its own.
description.zh: 通过 Jina 或 Cohere 兼容的 /rerank 接口提供重排序，供使用 dsh-ai-providers 共享服务的插件调用，单独安装不起作用。

description.en: DSH pure Plan B plugin bundle: .dspack export/import with multiple profiles, zero changes to official source, zero third-party plugins.
description.zh: 导出和导入 .dspack 插件包，支持多个 Profile，无需修改 DSH 官方源码。

description.en: Inspect local tools, model configuration, hardware and listening ports, and export diagnostics.
description.zh: 检查系统、命令行工具、模型配置、硬件与监听端口，并导出诊断。

description.en: Inspect model catalogs, provider status, balances and usage, and connect locally installed coding agents.
description.zh: 查看模型目录、供应商状态、余额配额与用量，并接入本机编程助手。

description.en: Host-side plugin for DSH Remote Control: pairs this machine's DeepSeek Harness with a relay so a WeChat mini program can send commands, stream output, and answer approvals. Payloads are end-to-end encrypted.
description.zh: 将本机 DSH 连接到中继，通过微信小程序发送指令、查看流式输出和处理审批；消息内容端到端加密。

description.en: DSH provider plugin for Codex access through a ChatGPT subscription.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT 订阅在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型。

description.en: Search DBLP and arXiv, retrieve BibTeX citations and access available paper full text.
description.zh: 检索 DBLP 和 arXiv，获取 BibTeX 引用及可用的论文全文。

description.en: Use an interactive terminal interface with tables, charts, Mermaid diagrams and side conversations.
description.zh: 提供交互式终端界面，支持表格、图表、Mermaid 和旁支会话。

description.en: Manage local novel projects, revision history and writing presets from a sidebar workbench.
description.zh: 在侧边工作台管理本地小说项目、修订记录和创作预设。

description.en: Download invoice attachments from QQ or 163 mail over IMAP, run OCR locally, file them by rule and produce an Excel summary. Requires Python 3.10+ on Windows x64 or Apple Silicon.
description.zh: 通过 IMAP 从 QQ 或 163 邮箱下载发票附件，本地 OCR 识别后按规则归档，并生成 Excel 汇总。需要 Python 3.10+，支持 Windows x64 和 Apple Silicon。

description.en: Recall experience strategies before tasks and record evaluations from checks and later feedback.
description.zh: 在任务前召回经验策略，根据检查结果和后续反馈记录评价。

description.en: Route shell commands and file access into disposable, per-project Podman containers, with approval-aware privilege escalation.
description.zh: 把命令执行和文件访问都放进按项目隔离的一次性 Podman 容器，并支持需审批的权限提升。

description.en: DSH Cordis plugin: hooks the core model-request seam (agent/pre-step and agent/request) to force-compact a session's context and disable thinking per the 强制压缩配置 settings namespace.
description.zh: 在模型请求前按设置强制压缩上下文，并可关闭模型思考。

description.en: DSH Cordis plugin: announces the moment an agent finishes (turns idle) by pushing a 'done' signal from the host half into the falling-ts-web-ding settings namespace that the browser half reads.
description.zh: 在 Agent 完成任务并进入空闲时，向网页界面发送完成提示音信号。

description.en: Track token and cache usage, account balances and billing, with exportable records.
description.zh: 追踪 Token 与缓存用量、账户余额和费用，并导出记录。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN change preview for DSH.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的只读 Git 与 SVN 变更预览。

description.en: Run board or list tasks through DSH sessions and sync their status in host-side storage.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 会话执行看板或清单中的任务，把状态回写到宿主端共享存储。

description.en: Fish's all-in-one DSH plugin bundle, inserting plugin rows for 13 plugins in one click. Eleven are subpackages in this repo, such as approval-guide and git-graph-fish, and two are external add-ons.
description.zh: 一键添加 Fish 插件合集中的 13 个插件，其中包含本仓库组件和外部配套插件。

description.en: Permanently deletes a DeepSeek Harness conversation and all its local data: session log, derived caches, workspace index entries, spill files, and unreferenced attachments.
description.zh: 永久删除会话及其本地数据，包括日志、缓存、工作区索引记录和不再引用的附件。

description.en: Store conversation knowledge in Markdown cognitive graphs with recall and reflection tools.
description.zh: 将会话知识保存到 Markdown 认知图，提供召回与反思工具。

description.en: Fylar Office Editor integration for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile, powered by Fylar Office SDK
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页中接入 Fylar Office SDK 文档编辑器。

description.en: Restart or upgrade DSH, inspect runtime health, and manage backups and Linux permissions from a web panel.
description.zh: 在网页面板中重启或升级 DSH、查看运行状态，并管理备份和 Linux 权限。

description.en: Agent-Native document handling for DSH — addressable blocks let an agent read and edit one section instead of the whole file. Ships the geml MCP server and the authoring and code-graph skills.
description.zh: 按内容块读取和编辑文档，内置 GEML MCP 服务及文档编写、代码关系图技能。

description.en: Transcribe and search PDFs, then read papers with a built-in viewer and conversation tools.
description.zh: 提取和检索 PDF 内容，通过内置阅读器配合会话阅读论文。

description.en: Add a generate_image tool backed by FAL, any OpenAI-compatible image API or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, with results shown inline and optional approval and budget limits.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接 FAL、OpenAI 兼容的图像接口或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，图片直接显示在对话中，可设置审批和预算上限。

description.en: Provide switchable Russian localization for DSH and ecosystem plugins.
description.zh: 为 DSH 核心与生态插件提供可切换的俄语界面。

description.en: Ask side questions using the current conversation while the main task continues. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; side history disappears on reload and side requests cannot run tools.
description.zh: 借助当前会话上下文旁聊，主任务可继续运行。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，刷新后旁聊历史清空，旁聊不能执行工具。

description.en: Manage appearance and themes, browse a visual community market, and check themes before applying them. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; some checks need a Chromium download.
description.zh: 管理外观与主题，浏览带预览图的社区市场，安装检查通过后应用主题。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，部分检查需要下载 Chromium。

description.en: Export and import session packages, relocate workspaces and sessions, and synchronize them between machines.
description.zh: 导入导出会话包，迁移工作区与会话目录，并在机器之间同步会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding two code-quality skills: /simplify (behavior-preserving cleanups of the current diff) and /code-review (multi-angle review).
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 和 /code-review 技能，清理当前改动并进行多角度代码审查。

description.en: Desktop notifications when a DeepSeek Harness turn ends: bundled Python/PowerShell notifier, custom command fallback, and its own Settings page.
description.zh: 在会话轮次结束时发送桌面通知，提供 Python/PowerShell 通知器，也可执行自定义通知命令。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: aligns the Markdown pipe tables touched by each write or edit, and reports what changed.
description.zh: 自动对齐写入或编辑的 Markdown 表格，并说明改动内容。

description.en: dsh-tianshu-tui: an interactive terminal UI plugin for the official DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown/tool cards, 16+ themes, slash commands, session tabs, LSP diagnostics, cost tracking, self-update (`dsh plugin --profile tui add @huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui`)
description.zh: 在终端中浏览流式回复、工具卡片、会话、诊断与费用。

description.en: Configure reasoning effort for third-party models and default subagent settings.
description.zh: 为第三方模型配置思考强度，并设置子 Agent 的默认档位。

description.en: Install reusable plugin templates, development tools and a bundled starter collection.
description.zh: 安装可复用的插件模板、开发工具与入门组合包。

description.en: Open an OpenBMC web console from DSH settings through an SSH-forwarded same-origin proxy that follows BMC IP changes. Requires an SSH jump host that can reach the BMC.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里经 SSH 转发的同源代理打开 OpenBMC 网页控制台，BMC IP 变化时自动重新连接。需要能访问 BMC 的 SSH 跳板机。

description.en: Install a Windows variant of the minimal agent preset that runs bash through Git for Windows. Commands run only under the full-access policy.
description.zh: 安装极简模式的 Windows 版预设，通过 Git for Windows 的 bash 执行命令。仅在完全访问权限下运行命令。

description.en: Manage global or project skills and MCP servers, and inspect the tools exposed by each server.
description.zh: 管理全局或项目级技能与 MCP 服务器，并查看服务器提供的工具。

description.en: dsh workspace code review plugin: wraps open-code-review (ocr CLI) as 5 model tools, plus a settings card that applies a provider and model from the host provider list to the OCR config.
description.zh: 将 open-code-review 命令行接入 DSH 代码审查，并在设置中选择审查所用的供应商和模型。

description.en: Semantic workspace search plugin for DSH (zg): zg_search, zg_index, and zg_status, plus a local embedding settings card, systemPrompt routing rules, and a guard safety net.
description.zh: 用 Zvec 对工作区建立语义索引并搜索，提供本地向量模型配置和调用规则。

description.en: Connect a ChatGPT account, choose a proxy, and view usage and reset credits.
description.zh: 连接 ChatGPT 账户，选择代理，并查看用量、剩余额度及重置时间。

description.en: Codex-style streaming, thinking blocks, tool activity, and deliverable previews.
description.zh: 提供 Codex 风格的流式回复、思考内容、工具活动和产物预览。

description.en: Set image input and reasoning levels for third-party provider models.
description.zh: 为第三方模型设置图片输入能力和推理强度。

description.en: Rewrite the composer draft through an auxiliary model, or request a command result without changing the draft.
description.zh: 通过辅助模型改写输入框草稿，也可用命令查看结果而不修改草稿。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: the read_document tool reads Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files as Markdown for the model
description.zh: 将 Word、PPT、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 转为模型可读的 Markdown。

description.en: Command Code Go provider adapter for dsh: scan the Go-plan model catalog dynamically and serve /alpha/generate through the harness LLM seam
description.zh: 接入 Command Code Go 套餐，自动读取可用模型并在 DSH 中调用。

description.en: OpenCode Zen free models provider for dsh
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型通道。

description.en: Browse, search and preview workspace files, then insert references by clicking or dragging.
description.zh: 在侧栏浏览、搜索和预览文件，点击或拖拽插入引用。

description.en: Withdraw turns from the visible conversation and model context while preserving logs and quarantining affected file changes.
description.zh: 撤回指定轮次，使其退出界面与模型上下文；保留日志，并隔离相关文件改动。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页服务成功启动后，执行用户设定的命令。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (memory palace · AGI Architecture Exploration on dsh-market): dual-scope SQLite memory graph, hybrid retrieval, provenance audit, and a knowledge flywheel.
description.zh: 用 SQLite 记忆图、混合检索和来源记录保存跨会话知识。

description.en: Usage billing dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar cost metrics plus a full dashboard modal, priced from a current multi-provider catalog with real usage aggregated from session logs.
description.zh: 从会话日志汇总实际用量，显示多供应商价格与侧栏费用指标。

description.en: Auto Title: keeps session titles following the latest task; names you set by hand stay put.
description.zh: 随最新任务自动更新会话标题，保留手动设置的名称。

description.en: Read official DSH documentation in the plugin page and search docs or npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: 在插件页阅读 DSH 官方文档，并用原生工具检索文档和 npm 元数据。

description.en: Sidekick: persistent Lead–Sidekick collaboration. Delegate bounded tasks, then accept or send back exact results.
description.zh: 让主模型与 Sidekick 持续协作，委派明确范围的任务，逐项验收或退回修改。

description.en: Git Commit: commit workspace changes from the conversation header, with model-planned commit groups.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏提交工作区改动，由模型规划提交分组。

description.en: Long-term Memory: remember vocabulary, preferences, and recent activity per scope, consolidated by Dream.
description.zh: 按作用范围保存词汇、偏好和近期活动，通过 Dream 整理长期记忆。

description.en: Session Recap: writes session recaps in the background and gives the agent bounded progress checkpoints.
description.zh: 在后台生成会话摘要，记录阶段进度，供 Agent 后续继续工作。

description.en: Zhihu search, agent tools, knowledge bases, and usage tracking for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供知乎搜索、Agent 工具、知识库及用量追踪。

description.en: ZPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness, with durable API-key settings and CLI configuration.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 ZPDF 工具，支持 API 密钥保存和命令行配置。

description.en: DSH bundle: push Bark notifications to iPhone and Apple Watch when an agent finishes a run, needs approval, or errors out.
description.zh: 在任务完成、需要审批或出错时，通过 Bark 通知 iPhone 和 Apple Watch。

description.en: Third-party macOS menu bar activity indicator for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 macOS 菜单栏显示 DSH 的运行状态。

description.en: Session-sync plugin for DeepSeek Harness: git-backed cross-machine session sync with its own web settings surface, row-menu action, and sync-records dialog
description.zh: 通过 Git 在多台机器间同步会话，在网页设置和会话菜单中管理同步记录。

description.en: Browse branch history and run workspace Git operations from the web interface.
description.zh: 在网页界面查看分支历史，并操作工作区 Git 仓库。

description.en: Browse and install community plugins, skins and pets from the web interface.
description.zh: 在网页界面浏览并安装社区插件、皮肤和宠物。

description.en: Download, register, disable and uninstall community agent presets from the Workshop.
description.zh: 在工坊中下载、注册、停用和卸载社区 Agent 预设。

description.en: Browse, enable, create and remove skills grouped by their source.
description.zh: 按来源浏览、开关、创建和删除技能。

description.en: In-GUI skin center for the dsh web GUI — the single skin package: skins are pure asset directories (built-in plus $DSH_HOME/skins) loaded and rendered only by the skin center; live try-on and one-click apply switch atomically in the page (no reload, no cordis.patch.yml rewrite, no restart)
description.zh: 浏览本地主题素材，实时试用并应用网页皮肤。

description.en: Manage agent tasks, scheduled runs and execution state from the web interface.
description.zh: 在网页界面管理 Agent 任务、定时执行和运行状态。

description.en: Synchronize GitHub Issues with a task board in the DSH web interface.
description.zh: 把 GitHub Issues 同步到 DSH 网页任务看板。

description.en: Gather the switches and settings of the dsh-web plugin family into one section of the DSH settings page.
description.zh: 把 dsh-web 系列插件的开关和配置表单集中到 DSH 设置页的一个分区里。

description.en: LiangShen (梁神) agent preset and its composer lever for the dsh web GUI. The host declares the bundled preset to the agent-preset registry at activation, so it can be selected for new sessions.
description.zh: 提供梁神 Agent 预设及输入框切换入口，可在新会话中选用。

description.en: Multi-pet companion plugin for the DSH web GUI: a registry-driven floating pet that reacts to model activity, with per-pet naming, petting and feeding, and an affinity system.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页添加多只宠物，随模型活动做出反应，支持命名、抚摸、喂食和好感度。

description.en: Pair phones and computers with the web interface over LAN or an optional Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 通过局域网或 Cloudflare 隧道扫码配对手机与电脑，访问同一网页界面。

description.en: Connect SSH hosts with remote commands, terminals, SFTP and port forwarding.
description.zh: 连接 SSH 主机，使用远程命令、终端、SFTP 与端口转发。

description.en: Usage statistics plugin for the dsh web GUI: per-provider balance and coding-plan quota detection, plus a live token usage ledger with a compact price glance card.
description.zh: 查看各供应商余额与套餐额度，通过实时用量账本和价格卡片了解费用。

description.en: Install a collection of task, Git, remote-access and appearance extensions for the web interface.
description.zh: 组合安装任务、Git、远程访问和界面外观扩展。

description.en: Add image understanding for text-only models through a separate vision provider.
description.zh: 通过独立视觉供应商为纯文本模型提供图片理解。

description.en: Search the web and X, fetch page content, and switch between search engines when a request fails.
description.zh: 搜索网页和 X 内容、抓取正文，并在请求失败时切换搜索引擎。

description.en: A real PowerPoint, not HTML. Editable .pptx decks for AI agents, rendered on your own machine.
description.zh: 在本机生成、渲染可继续编辑的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。

description.en: Delete sessions and their owned subagents from the interface or a tool, stopping running sessions and clearing stored artifacts.
description.zh: 从界面或工具删除会话及其拥有的子 Agent，会先停止运行会话并清理存储产物。

description.en: Infrastructure for the self-evolution automation family, without the memory and skill tools. Pair it with the Evolution agent preset and do not install it alongside the preset bundle. Validated on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 自我进化自动化系列的基础设施包，不含记忆和技能工具，需搭配 Evolution 智能体预设使用，不要与一键预设包同时安装。已在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上验证。

description.en: Apply allow and deny rules plus a classifier before tool execution to handle permission approvals.
description.zh: 在工具执行前结合允许、拒绝规则和分类器处理权限审批。

description.en: Manage the skills DSH actually loads from Settings: see where each comes from, enable or disable it without touching its files, edit SKILL.md, and import or delete skills. Deletion is permanent.
description.zh: 在设置页管理 DSH 实际会加载的技能：查看来源和覆盖关系，不改文件即可启停，编辑 SKILL.md，导入或删除技能。删除后无法恢复。

description.en: Standalone OpenTelemetry GenAI observability plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 OpenTelemetry 生成式 AI 可观测数据。

description.en: Download, browse and edit files through the browser when DSH runs in a container without local filesystem access.
description.zh: 当 DSH 运行在不能直接读取用户本机文件的容器中时，通过浏览器浏览、编辑和下载文件。

description.en: Persistent engineering memory for coding agents, isolated per project, backed by evidence and checked against the current repository, with optional code intelligence and hybrid search.
description.zh: 为编程 Agent 提供按项目隔离、附带证据并对照当前仓库校验的工程记忆，可选代码结构分析和混合检索。

description.en: Plugin for the A6API multi-model aggregator: native LLM provider registration, live account balance and price-change monitoring, token allowlist sync, merchant route probing, and a panoramic metrics card.
description.zh: 接入 A6API 模型，查看余额和价格变化，同步密钥使用的模型范围，并检查线路。

description.en: Assistant reply translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI (OpenAI-compatible channel).
description.zh: 通过兼容 OpenAI 的模型接口，翻译网页会话中的助手回复。

description.en: Provides the current Web instance's tokenized access URL to the model and shell via DSH_WEB_AUTH_URL, resolved on each shell call, plus a cookie-jar usage note. Secrets stay out of prompts and transcripts.
description.zh: 通过 DSH_WEB_AUTH_URL 向 Shell 提供当前网页实例的认证地址，在执行时解析令牌，避免写入提示词和会话记录。

description.en: Con's auto review (DCAR): a DeepSeek Harness tool review plugin that applies deterministic rules first and escalates to an LLM on demand, with a CAutoR permission mode.
description.zh: 优先按程序规则复核工具调用，复杂情况再交给模型，提供 CAutoR 权限模式。

description.en: The /cron command for DeepSeek Harness: runs a prompt on a cron expression or plain-English schedule, parsed in code, with the model as a last resort.
description.zh: 通过 /cron 按 cron 表达式或自然语言安排定时任务，优先由代码解析，必要时使用模型。

description.en: Google Vertex AI provider for DeepSeek Harness: service-account auth for Google-hosted Claude and Gemini models.
description.zh: 通过服务账号接入 Google Vertex AI，使用其托管的 Claude 和 Gemini 模型。

description.en: Register Command Code models and a provider configuration card in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中注册 Command Code 模型与供应商配置卡片。

description.en: Configure speech engines such as Edge TTS and read messages manually or automatically.
description.zh: 配置 Edge TTS 等语音引擎，手动或自动朗读消息。

description.en: Summon any of 331 domain experts or five built-in expert teams in DSH for reviews, design, operations and research, with the main session pulling the results together.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中召唤 331 位专业智能体或 5 个内置专家团，协助代码审查、设计、运营和研究，由主会话汇总结果。

description.en: Archive, restore, favorite and remove sessions, and diagnose damaged session logs.
description.zh: 归档、恢复、收藏和删除会话，并诊断损坏的会话日志。

description.en: Schedule one-off or recurring coding tasks that run in their own DSH sessions with a chosen workspace, model, skills and permissions, and review each run afterwards.
description.zh: 按计划在独立的 DSH 会话中执行一次性或周期性编码任务，可设置工作目录、模型、技能和权限，并回看每次运行的结果。

description.en: Answers from the current context in an independent bubble, without running tools.
description.zh: 根据当前上下文在独立气泡中回答旁支问题，不调用工具。

description.en: A Codex-style sidebar for DSH Web with a workspace session tree, global search and turn navigation, in light and dark themes. Do not enable it together with ds-bot.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 Codex 风格的侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航，支持浅色和深色主题。不要与 ds-bot 同时启用。

description.en: Hand tasks to your local DSH from Feishu, Lark, DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat, QQ, Telegram, Discord or Slack, and get replies, answer questions and approve tools in the same chat.
description.zh: 通过飞书、Lark、钉钉、企业微信、微信、QQ、Telegram、Discord 或 Slack 把任务交给本机 DSH，并在同一聊天里接收回复、回答问题和审批工具。

description.en: Bring PUA to DSH: push the agent to change approach and verify results instead of giving up or declaring done too early, with persona styles, acceptance loops and status cards. Results depend on the model.
description.zh: 把 PUA 带到 DSH：在 Agent 反复失败、过早放弃或草率宣告完成时，引导它换方法、拿证据，提供多种风格、验收循环和状态卡片。效果取决于所用模型。

description.en: Run /simplify to have the agent tidy code within the current Git changes, the staged files, a commit or a path, keeping behavior unchanged. Prompts are in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 输入 /simplify，让 Agent 在当前 Git 改动、暂存区、指定提交或路径范围内整理代码，保持原有功能。提示词为简体中文。

description.en: Manage local and project skills with repository installs, update previews, backups, and restoration.
description.zh: 管理本机与项目技能，支持仓库安装、更新预览及备份恢复。

description.en: Better Sidebar for DSH: file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, kept separate per conversation, plus a service other plugins use to register sidebar items.
description.zh: 在同一侧栏查看文件、编辑器、变更、任务和旁聊，各会话分别保存状态，也可供其他插件扩展。

description.en: Cross-session memory: auto-distill each session into a local SQLite store, inject on demand, consolidate while idle (autoDream).
description.zh: 将会话内容提炼并保存到本机 SQLite，按需调取，空闲时自动整理记忆。

description.en: Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2
description.zh: 为 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 接入自定义 Claude 供应商。

description.en: Harness-neutral reliability infrastructure for AI coding agents: reversible destructive actions, pre-emission redaction, recovery evidence, and a shared Decision Protocol with optional native adapters.
description.zh: 为编程 Agent 提供可撤销的高风险操作、输出脱敏、恢复记录和共享决策协议。

description.en: Generate images, video, music and speech through multiple providers, with transcription and visual analysis tools.
description.zh: 接入多家供应商生成图片、视频、音乐和语音，并提供转写与视觉分析工具。

description.en: Browse, search, and install SkillHub skills inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索并安装 SkillHub 技能。

description.en: Manage MCP server configuration, startup, reconnection and tool switches, and import JSON configurations.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器配置、启停、重连和工具开关，并导入 JSON 配置。

description.en: A bundle of session plugins that adds in-place edit, retry, recall and fork to conversations in DSH Web.
description.zh: 组合多个会话插件，为 DSH Web 的对话提供就地编辑、重试、撤回和分支。

description.en: Ollama bundle: configures the ollama provider for llm-pi-ai and sets web_search to use the Ollama backend, including provider selection in the web row, all in one go.
description.zh: 配置 Ollama 模型供应商和网页搜索后端，可在网页中切换。

description.en: Session modes and injection surface: mode rows (persona, tool and policy lists, toggles), a subagent takeover row, injection channels and tool descriptions. Row lists come from the session's shipped preset; this package adds no preset.
description.zh: 为预设提供会话模式、工具权限和提示词注入设置；模式内容由会话使用的预设提供。

description.en: Store project pitfalls and reusable practices in separate volumes, with monotonic identifiers and synchronized indexes.
description.zh: 分册保存项目常见问题和可复用做法，用递增编号管理条目并同步索引。

description.en: Detect repeated reasoning and output patterns and interrupt degenerate model calls.
description.zh: 检测重复思考与输出模式，中断陷入循环的模型调用。

description.en: Review tool calls using global and project rules, with categorized approvals, inline diffs and sandbox escalation handling.
description.zh: 结合全局与项目规则复核工具调用，显示改动差异，并处理需要在沙箱外执行的请求。

description.en: Use skills to guide engineering tasks through the harness and agent loop.
description.zh: 通过技能组织工程任务，协调 DSH 与 Agent 的执行流程。

description.en: Render model-authored openui-lang programs as editable lists, tables, charts, controls and drawings in chat.
description.zh: 把模型生成的 openui-lang 程序渲染为对话中的可编辑列表、表格、图表、控件和绘图。

description.en: A parody that dresses DSH up as a 2005 web portal with fake ads, pop-ups and a jackpot wheel. Answers keep generating in the background but wait for the ad to finish; ad slots link to real dsh-plugin repositories.
description.zh: 恶搞插件：把 DSH 变成 2005 年风格的门户网站，塞满假广告、弹窗和抽奖转盘。回答在后台照常生成，只是要等广告播完才显示；广告位会推荐真实的 dsh-plugin 仓库。

description.en: Render interactive HTML fragments as sandboxed cards inside conversation replies.
description.zh: 在会话回复中将交互 HTML 片段渲染为沙箱卡片。

description.en: Coordinate agent teams with task dependencies, direct messaging and a web monitor.
description.zh: 通过任务依赖、直接消息与网页监视器协调 Agent 团队。

description.en: Translate selected text using public translation endpoints or a model configured in the current harness.
description.zh: 选中文字后，通过公共翻译接口或 DSH 已配置的模型翻译。

description.en: Node-based short-drama studio for DeepSeek Harness: script → storyboard → assets → shots → voiced, subtitled final cut on an infinite canvas.
description.zh: 在无限画布中编写剧本、整理分镜与素材，制作带配音和字幕的短剧。

description.en: Apply Catppuccin color schemes and an optional translucent web skin.
description.zh: 应用 Catppuccin 配色与可选的半透明网页皮肤。

description.en: Manage plugin sources and framework upgrades with rollback and compatibility gates.
description.zh: 管理插件来源与框架升级，支持回滚和兼容性检查。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: control the Unity Editor through the unity CLI — project management, live-editor pipeline commands, and C# eval as agent tools.
description.zh: 通过 Unity 命令行管理项目、执行编辑器流程和 C# 代码。

description.en: Free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native dsh-llm adapter plugin, no API key.
description.zh: 通过原生适配器为 DSH 接入 OpenCode Zen 模型。

description.en: Terminal-native ACP client UI; Cordis client tree, any ACP agent
description.zh: 在终端中使用 DSH 或其他兼容 ACP 的 Agent，并通过 Cordis 插件扩展界面。

description.en: Connect OpenViking memory and context services to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 OpenViking 记忆与上下文服务。

description.en: Pando desktop pet for the DSH UI, a replica of the confirmo.love companion with a local sprite directory and community sprites. Drag to move and right-click to switch sprites.
description.zh: 添加 Pando 桌宠，支持本地及社区精灵图，拖动位置、右键切换角色。

description.en: Tavily web search for DSH (keyless or keyed, official DeepSeek when off), plus the Tavily MCP: search, extract, crawl, map and research.
description.zh: 接入 Tavily 网页搜索和 MCP 的提取、抓取、站点映射与研究工具；关闭后使用 DeepSeek 默认搜索。

description.en: View local AI usage and optionally submit anonymous data to a rolling seven-day ranking.
description.zh: 查看本地 AI 用量，并可选择匿名参与近七日用量排行。

description.en: Six features in one bundle, including a transparent, always-on-top desktop pet from codex-pets.net and a global wallpaper from wallhaven.cc or a local image.
description.zh: 提供桌宠、壁纸等六项功能，可使用 codex-pets.net 角色、wallhaven.cc 壁纸或本地图片。

description.en: Settings page for the DSH web GUI's MCP servers: a JSON editor over a profile-config namespace that mounts live mcp-client instances from the saved servers.
description.zh: 通过 JSON 编辑器配置 MCP 服务器，保存后按配置建立连接。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness billing plugin: shows account balance and this session's billed spend, with a session-header badge.
description.zh: 显示账户余额和当前会话的实际计费金额，在会话标题旁提供费用标记。

description.en: Local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness in a single package: JSONL storage, local vector search (BGE-M3), four model tools, automatic recall injection, and a management panel.
description.zh: 用本地 JSONL 和 BGE-M3 向量检索保存长期记忆，支持自动召回和面板管理。

description.en: DSH memory panel: browse, search, edit, and delete memories in Settings, and manually start or stop the local vector service.
description.zh: 在设置中浏览、搜索、编辑和删除记忆，并手动启停本地向量服务。

description.en: Inspect visible skills and their sources, read SKILL.md, manage invocation permissions, and create or soft-delete skills.
description.zh: 查看当前会话可用技能与来源，阅读说明、管理权限，并创建或移入回收区。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness browser provider: reads a page as an indexed action space, then runs one guarded operation at a time.
description.zh: 把网页内容整理成带编号的可操作目标，再逐步执行带权限检查的浏览器操作。

description.en: Full-featured Mem0 integration for DSH: auto-recall, consolidation, 7 tools, influence scores, provenance, and a trace viewer.
description.zh: 通过 Mem0 自动召回和整理记忆，提供来源追溯、影响评分和记录查看。

description.en: Manage project tasks in a local SQLite board with agent assignments, execution tracking and human review.
description.zh: 用本地 SQLite 看板管理项目任务，支持 Agent 领取、执行跟踪和人工验收。

description.en: Turn a directory into an AI workspace with its own memory, rules, tools and boundaries, so work resumes where it stopped after model switches and restarts. Requires Node 20+.
description.zh: 把普通目录变成 AI 工作区，自带记忆、规范、工具和边界，换模型或重启后都能接着做。需要 Node 20 以上。

description.en: View desktop usage, provider quotas and custom queries, with optional WorkBuddy credits and an extended model selector.
description.zh: 查看桌面用量、供应商配额与自定义查询，可选 WorkBuddy 积分和扩展模型选择器。

description.en: Switch installed skins and edit each skin's options from Settings.
description.zh: 在设置页切换已安装的皮肤，并调整各皮肤自带的选项。

description.en: Apply a navy whale-maid theme and character sidebar to the web interface.
description.zh: 为网页界面添加深蓝鲸鱼女仆主题与角色侧栏。

description.en: Apply a black-whale theme with square corners, straight-line icons and light and dark palettes.
description.zh: 提供黑鲸主题、直角界面、线条图标及明暗配色。

description.en: Add unread-delivery indicators and popup notifications to the native automation task interface.
description.zh: 为原生自动化任务界面增加未读投递标记和弹出通知。

description.en: Federated plugin discovery and update UI for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x, integrated with the native Plugin Manager.
description.zh: 汇总多个来源的插件，提供发现和更新界面，并与 DSH 原生插件管理器集成。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the DeepSeek API account balance, shown beside Settings at the sidebar foot.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部的设置按钮旁显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额。

description.en: QQ Bot IM channel plugin for deepseek-harness (dsh)
description.zh: 通过 QQ Bot 连接 DSH 消息与会话。

description.en: Capture conversation excerpts or new notes, organize them with tags and search, and manage trash and backups.
description.zh: 摘录会话或新建笔记，用标签整理和搜索，并管理回收站与备份。

description.en: Connect CodeBuddy models through browser OAuth, with account switching, model capabilities and quota display.
description.zh: 通过浏览器 OAuth 接入 CodeBuddy 模型，支持账号切换、模型能力查看和额度显示。

description.en: fnOS-specific integrations for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 fnOS 专用集成。

description.en: Hosts a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge that exposes every model configured in DSH to Midscene browser automation. Midscene can drive pages in natural language without holding any credential itself.
description.zh: 在本机建立兼容 OpenAI 的桥接服务，让 Midscene 使用 DSH 模型进行浏览器自动化，凭据由桥接端处理。

description.en: Terminal front door for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): an out-of-tree TUI mode bundle over dsh-base
description.zh: 为 DSH 配置提供独立的终端界面组合包。

description.en: Read and write WPS 365 cloud documents through the local CLI, with conflict checks before writes; requires an enterprise account.
description.zh: 通过本机 CLI 读写 WPS 365 云文档，写入前检查并发冲突，需要企业版账号。

description.en: Turn plans and codebases into interactive architecture diagrams through a bundled skill.
description.zh: 用内置技能把方案与代码库整理为可交互的架构图。

description.en: Run one project across your own Windows and macOS machines from a single DeepSeek account, with replicate, split, broadcast and pipeline modes.
description.zh: 用同一个 DeepSeek 账号在你自己的 Windows 和 macOS 机器上运行同一个项目，支持复制、拆分、广播和流水线四种协同方式。

description.en: Adjust model reasoning effort with a configurable slider in the web interface.
description.zh: 通过网页界面的可配置滑块调整模型推理强度。

description.en: Shows provider API balance and subscription quotas as an always-visible dsh Web sidebar card, or the original composer pill, for the provider behind the model used in this conversation.
description.zh: 在侧栏卡片或输入框旁显示当前模型供应商的 API 余额与订阅额度。

description.en: Query A-share prices, financials, announcements and news, then organize analysis and charts.
description.zh: 查询 A 股行情、财务数据、公告和新闻，并整理分析与图表。

description.en: VibeDev Ecosystem: discover, install, and manage plugins made by VibeDev, verify stable release updates in real time, and browse the DSH community marketplace.
description.zh: 发现、安装和管理 VibeDev 插件，检查版本更新，并浏览 DSH 社区市场。

description.en: Right-sidebar media preview for inline video, audio and HTML, plus a folder gallery where selected media can be added to the video workspace canvas. Works in DSH's sidebar and in dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 在右侧栏预览视频、音频和 HTML，浏览文件夹媒体并选入影视工作台；HTML 默认允许脚本。

description.en: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness: session affinity, Zen/Go gateway origin headers, free-tier tool fallback, and live Go quota display.
description.zh: 接入 OpenCode Zen/Go，保持会话与网关的对应关系，提供免费档工具调用回退和 Go 额度显示。

description.en: TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web), offering $0 SERP and page extraction, direct or via Monid.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页搜索和正文提取接入 TinyFish，支持直连或通过 Monid 调用。

description.en: Send DSH model requests through Sabi's local proxy, which picks the configured upstream model. Written against DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的模型请求交给 Sabi 本地代理，由它按配置选择上游模型。基于 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 开发。

description.en: Manage local skills from multiple coding agents, import them into DSH and browse a skill market.
description.zh: 管理多个编程助手的本地技能，导入 DSH，并浏览技能市场。

description.en: Global Cloudflare Code Mode MCP bundle: after installation, all DSH sessions automatically get the docs/search/execute tools and the cfbridge skill, working with the project-local Wrangler CLI passthrough.
description.zh: 为所有 DSH 会话接入 Cloudflare Code Mode MCP 的文档、搜索和执行工具，配合项目本地 Wrangler 使用。

description.en: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss.
description.zh: 将 ponytail 的工作方式和七级处理流程接入 DSH，提供六个可独立开关的技能及双语说明。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Claude Code-style prompt history with Up/Down navigation, a double-Esc history search picker, and selection quote/copy with right-click paste.
description.zh: 通过上下键和双击 Esc 查找提示词历史，支持划选引用、复制和右键粘贴。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 15 obra/superpowers engineering skills, bilingual descriptions, per-skill toggles
description.zh: 接入 obra/superpowers 的 15 个工程技能，支持双语说明和逐项开关。

description.en: Scan the QR code to keep using DeepSeek Harness on mobile or public networks when you're away from your computer. One-tap LAN QR code, Cloudflare public tunnel, self-hosted tunnel, and WeChat / QQ / Lark / Telegram bots (multi-workspace / session persistence / media / card approval / streaming output), no public server required.
description.zh: 通过扫码、局域网、隧道或聊天机器人远程使用 DSH，支持多工作区、会话同步、媒体消息与审批。

description.en: Search online skill catalogs, install skills into user or project directories and manage local skills.
description.zh: 搜索在线技能目录，把技能安装到用户或项目目录，并管理本地技能。

description.en: Let the agent browse websites, fill forms and take screenshots in your real, signed-in Chrome or Edge through Tencent BrowserSkill, with a live view in DSH Web. Requires the bsk CLI and browser extension.
description.zh: 通过腾讯 BrowserSkill，让 Agent 在你已登录的 Chrome 或 Edge 中浏览网页、填写表单和截图，并在 DSH Web 里实时查看。需要安装 bsk 命令行和浏览器扩展。

description.en: An IDE-style Git panel for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web GUI. It provides branch and history overview, uncommitted changes with commit and amend, diff stats, and a zsh-style branch marker.
description.zh: 在网页中查看 Git 分支、历史和未提交改动，支持提交、修改上次提交及差异统计。

description.en: Remote access & authentication for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: login gate, MFA (TOTP), signed session cookies, role-based access, in-browser directory picker, account management settings. Fully localized (zh/en).
description.zh: 为网页界面提供登录、多因素认证、角色权限与远程目录选择。

description.en: Save reusable prompts and shell commands globally or per workspace, then run them from session controls.
description.zh: 按全局或工作区保存提示词与 Shell 命令，再从会话中执行。

description.en: Replace stock shell and file tools with persistent Bash, structured reads, multiple edit modes and atomic writes.
description.zh: 用持久 Bash、结构化文件读取、多种编辑方式、原子写入和安全删除替换基础工具。

description.en: Connect steps on a canvas and compile the graph into a dispatch plan for the model to execute.
description.zh: 在画布中连接步骤，将流程转换为模型可执行的任务计划。

description.en: Back up, restore and migrate DSH data with scheduled snapshots and session-log diagnostics.
description.zh: 通过定时快照备份、恢复和迁移 DSH 数据，并诊断会话日志。

description.en: Connects WeChat, Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, and Matrix to DSH.
description.zh: 将微信、飞书、企微、钉钉、QQ、Telegram、WhatsApp、Slack、Discord、Matrix 接入 DSH。

description.en: The dsh-pi-tui bundle: a TUI surface for DeepSeek Harness profiles (dsh --profile pi-tui)
description.zh: 为 DSH 配置安装 Pi 风格的终端界面。

description.en: Analyze and rewrite prompts beside the composer using the current session model.
description.zh: 使用当前会话模型，在输入栏旁分析并改写提示词。

description.en: Token usage, provider accounts, session cost estimates, budgets, and exports for the dsh web GUI
description.zh: 查看 Token 用量、供应商账户、会话费用、预算与导出记录。

description.en: Manage database connections and metadata catalogs, then query them through SQL and catalog tools.
description.zh: 管理数据库连接与元数据目录，通过 SQL 和目录工具进行查询。

description.en: MuseAI tavern for the dsh web GUI: a MuseAI conversation-view tab (right of Trajectory) with background / chat / adventure / bond / settings pages ported from MuseAI, running entirely on models configured in DeepSeek Harness (no separate API config)
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型配置上运行带聊天、冒险与角色页面的 MuseAI 界面。

description.en: Chain-of-thought keyword counting and highlighting with per-word count chips, a click-to-suppress switch, per-word colours, text colour and size, and whole-word matching.
description.zh: 统计和高亮思考内容中的关键词，可设置颜色、字号、完整词匹配，并点击隐藏指定词。

description.en: Persistent project memory for dsh agents: index docs (PDF/Markdown/text) and code symbols into a searchable per-workspace store, recall them with cited sources, and keep experience entries (problems -> solutions) searchable on demand.
description.zh: 索引工作区文档和代码，检索项目知识及问题解决经验，并保留来源引用。

description.en: Install and route the YottaMeta skill family, packaged with an MCP server.
description.zh: 安装并调度 YottaMeta 技能家族，内置 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Use structured learning skills and a lesson engine inside DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用结构化学习技能与课程引擎。

description.en: QQ Bot IM channel plugin for deepseek-harness (dsh)
description.zh: 通过 QQ Bot 为 DSH 提供即时消息通道。

description.en: DSH web plugin: VSCode Remote-SSH-like remote development (SSH to supercomputers/servers, remote workspace, file explorer, integrated terminal), integrated with dsh-better-sidebar and DSH settings.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 在服务器或超算上开发，在远程工作区使用文件浏览器和终端。

description.en: DSH developer tools: Git panel and startup management, as a manifest bundle where each component is its own package.
description.zh: 组合提供 Git 面板和启动管理，各功能以独立插件包安装。

description.en: Adjust conversation fonts, font sizes, line spacing and horizontal margins.
description.zh: 调整对话字体、字号、行间距和水平留白。

description.en: Start a local OpenCode2API backend with DSH and manage backend releases from Settings on Windows.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动本地 OpenCode2API 后端，适用于 Windows，并在插件设置页管理后端版本。

description.en: Provide a Tavily backend for web search, with credential storage, key rotation and failover.
description.zh: 为网页搜索接入 Tavily，支持凭据存储、密钥轮换和失败切换。

description.en: Manage SDKs, AVDs and emulators, scaffold Kotlin/Compose projects, and build, install, inspect and operate Android apps.
description.zh: 管理 SDK、AVD 和模拟器，创建 Kotlin/Compose 工程，并构建、安装、检查和操作 Android 应用。

description.en: Expose Xcode project, simulator, build, install, launch, screenshot and log operations as native agent tools.
description.zh: 把 Xcode 工程、模拟器、构建、安装、运行、截图和日志操作接为原生 Agent 工具。

description.en: Share Markdown memory across coding agents, with automatic capture, retrieval and review of skill candidates.
description.zh: 在多个编程 Agent 间共享 Markdown 记忆，支持自动记录、检索和技能候选审阅。

description.en: Combine output limits, result caching, file diffs, tool pruning and lazy MCP loading.
description.zh: 组合使用输出限制、结果缓存、文件差异、工具裁剪与 MCP 延迟加载。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Android — build, run, and interact with a live emulator or USB device stream inside a conversation, driven entirely through adb. Tested with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: 通过 adb 在会话中构建、运行并操作模拟器或 USB 设备。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex, as native subagents with live progress
description.zh: 从 Claude Code 或 Codex 调用 DSH 子 Agent，并查看实时进度。

description.en: A read-only mirror for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: capability inventory with evidence, cross-plugin conflicts, a diff of what changed since the last scan, and an upgrade preflight that tells you which profiles still boot on a newer DSH
description.zh: 只读查看已安装插件的能力、冲突和版本差异，附源码位置及升级前检查。

description.en: Build, run and interact with an iOS Simulator stream inside a conversation.
description.zh: 在会话中构建、运行并操作 iOS 模拟器画面。

description.en: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
description.zh: 通过 Noema 保存和检索长期记忆，可在设置页查看管理。

description.en: Preview, inspect, and edit real .op OpenPencil design documents inside DSH conversations — headless rendering, a read-only canvas, and a managed editor.
description.zh: 在会话中预览、检查与编辑 OpenPencil 设计文档。

description.en: Official A-share data API plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 31 tools covering quotes, K-lines, financials, sectors and backtesting; free tools need no key.
description.zh: 通过 A 股数据 API 查询行情、K 线、财务和板块，并运行回测；免费工具无需密钥。

description.en: Use local images or videos as backgrounds in the web and desktop interfaces.
description.zh: 为网页端和桌面端设置本地图片或视频背景。

description.en: Inspect related subagent sessions and delete selected conversation families from the sidebar.
description.zh: 查看关联子 Agent 会话，并在侧栏选择删除会话组。

description.en: Edit per-model reasoning levels, endpoint values, input modalities and token limits in Settings.
description.zh: 在设置中逐模型调整推理强度、服务地址、输入类型和 Token 上限。

description.en: Compress conversation context while retaining history for subsequent work.
description.zh: 压缩会话上下文，保留后续工作需要的历史信息。

description.en: Check destructive commands and access to sensitive files before tool execution.
description.zh: 在工具执行前检查破坏性命令及对密钥等敏感文件的访问。

description.en: Organize evidence-backed research as a browsable domain ontology.
description.zh: 将有证据支持的研究整理为可浏览的领域本体。

description.en: Provide a terminal coding interface and a staged /ship workflow for specifications, tests and acceptance.
description.zh: 提供终端编码界面和 /ship 工作流，分阶段完成需求说明、测试与验收。

description.en: Deep reading & summarization for DSH: books/papers/videos/web → structured Markdown notes (Obsidian / Logseq / static sites). Plugin parsers, MapReduce deep-read, JSON Schema-constrained sub-tasks.
description.zh: 将书籍、论文、视频和网页整理为结构化 Markdown 笔记。

description.en: Fail-closed password authentication proxy bundle for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页配置提供密码认证代理。

description.en: Custom background image plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: upload a local picture or paste an image URL, shown behind the whole app with adjustable opacity.
description.zh: 上传本地图片或粘贴图片链接作为网页背景，可调节透明度。

description.en: Adjust interface layout and conversation prompt behavior through configurable enhancements.
description.zh: 通过可配置扩展调整界面布局与会话提示词行为。

description.en: Use iPolloWork Design Studio and its curated templates as a conversation view in DSH. Declares support only for DSH versions before 0.2.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的对话视图中使用 iPolloWork 设计工作室及其精选模板。仅声明支持 0.2 之前的 DSH。

description.en: Use iPolloWork PPT Studio and its curated slide templates as a conversation view in DSH. Declares support only for DSH versions before 0.2.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的对话视图中使用 iPolloWork PPT 工作室及其精选幻灯片模板。仅声明支持 0.2 之前的 DSH。

description.en: Create long-lived bots with memory, direct messages and group chats for multi-bot collaboration.
description.zh: 创建带记忆的长期 Bot，通过私聊和群聊交流，并让多个 Bot 分工协作。

description.en: Continue DSH sessions from another computer, the web or Android over an end-to-end encrypted connection, with experimental support for Codex, Cursor and Antigravity workspaces.
description.zh: 通过端到端加密连接，在另一台电脑、网页或 Android 上继续使用 DSH 会话，另有 Codex、Cursor 和 Antigravity 工作区的实验支持。

description.en: Edit multilingual writing and coordinate long-form drafts with continuity checks. Requires Python 3.9+.
description.zh: 润色多语言写作，分块协作长文并检查上下文一致性，需要 Python 3.9+。

description.en: Configure the advisor reviewer model that observes the primary transcript and injects severity-ranked advice.
description.zh: 配置第二个模型旁观主会话，按严重程度给出审阅建议。

description.en: Language control for tool-call descriptions, model thinking and replies: follow the GUI language, force one, or turn it off.
description.zh: 控制工具说明、模型思考与回答所用的语言，可跟随界面或指定语言。

description.en: One-stop manager for skills, subagents, MCP, and LSP inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH), compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi, and other agent plugin layouts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中统一管理技能、子 Agent、MCP 和 LSP，兼容多种编程助手的插件目录结构。

description.en: Manage selectable profiles with roles, personality, speaking style, rules and memory, with import/export and injection controls.
description.zh: 管理可切换的角色、性格、表达、准则和记忆配置，支持导入导出及注入开关。

description.en: Compose prompts, tools, skills, subagents and fallback models in a visual configuration panel.
description.zh: 可视化组合提示词、工具、技能、子 Agent 与备用模型。

description.en: Fetch rendered pages, search multiple sources and automate indexed browser sessions.
description.zh: 抓取渲染后的网页、检索多个来源，并自动操作浏览器会话。

description.en: Use a floating workspace for image, video, short-drama and story creation tools.
description.zh: 在浮动工作区中使用图片、视频、短剧和故事创作工具。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth auth + model access plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account pool, 429 rotation, device fingerprinting, CLI and web login.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 连接 Google Antigravity，并管理多账户模型访问。

description.en: Customize theme colors and image or video wallpapers with separate opacity and blur controls for interface areas.
description.zh: 自定义主题色与图片或视频壁纸，分别调整各区域的透明度和模糊度。

description.en: Automatically discovers models on the Aperture gateway and adds them to DSH's model picker.
description.zh: 自动发现 Aperture 网关上的模型，并加入 DSH 的模型选择器。

description.en: Display balances across model providers and estimate session and subagent costs, including DeepSeek peak and off-peak pricing.
description.zh: 汇总多家模型供应商余额，估算会话与子 Agent 费用，并区分 DeepSeek 峰谷计价。

description.en: Search, run and build Apify Actors from DSH through the Apify MCP server and skills. Running Actors needs APIFY_TOKEN; the development skills need the Apify CLI.
description.zh: 通过 Apify MCP 服务器和技能，在 DSH 中搜索、运行和开发 Apify Actor。运行 Actor 需要 APIFY_TOKEN，开发类技能需要 Apify CLI。

description.en: Check aquaculture input records, including required fields, withdrawal periods and harvest date intervals.
description.zh: 核对养殖投入品记录的字段、休药期与起捕日期间隔，提示记录差异。

description.en: Check archive registers for required fields, duplicate identifiers, retention terms and transfer dates.
description.zh: 核对档案台账的必填字段、重复档号、保管期限用词和移交日期。

description.en: Favorites, copy id and path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a favorites filter for DSH conversations, as additive extensions to the shipped archive feature.
description.zh: 为已有归档功能增加收藏、筛选、复制 ID 和路径、单独删除及空闲时批量归档。

description.en: Balance and spending of an arckep.ru account inside the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI. Unofficial community plugin.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页界面中显示 arckep.ru 账户的余额与消费。非官方社区插件。

description.en: DSH image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image via Volcano Ark Seedream (Doubao). Zero dependencies, pure JavaScript, no build step.
description.zh: 通过火山方舟 Seedream（豆包）生成图片。

description.en: Immersive theme for Arknights players on the DSH Web GUI: twelve full-screen wallpapers with edge blur adapted to each image, glass and text colors computed per image, a Rhodes Island icon system, and signature-style authorization and selection interactions.
description.zh: 为《明日方舟》玩家提供壁纸、罗德岛图标、按图片调整的明暗配色和签字式授权交互。

description.en: Notify for approvals, questions and completed sessions with interactive cards, a desktop pet and browser wake recovery.
description.zh: 在审批、提问和会话完成时提醒，提供操作卡片、桌面宠物和浏览器唤醒重连。

description.en: Protect the web interface with passwords or shared tokens, session cookies and login rate limits.
description.zh: 为网页端添加密码或共享令牌登录、会话 Cookie、登录限速和用户管理命令。

description.en: Password login gateway for dsh web: auto-generated initial password with forced onboarding, login, password change with real request interception, and OTP two-factor auth.
description.zh: 为网页端添加密码登录、初次设置、密码修改和 OTP 双因素认证。

description.en: Claude Code style auto-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: typed memory files + MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt
description.zh: 自动注入 MEMORY.md 索引，管理分类的跨会话记忆文件。

description.en: Name sessions from the first message and stream title suggestions inside the rename dialog.
description.zh: 根据首条消息为会话命名，并在重命名弹窗中流式给出标题建议。

description.en: Second-model AI auto-review for DeepSeek Harness approval requests: a read-only reviewer subagent decides allow/deny on the approval answerer chain, with fail-closed fallback and full session-log audit.
description.zh: 由独立的只读模型复核权限请求，记录审批过程，复核失败时不自动放行。

description.en: Assign wallpapers and appearance settings to model rules and rotate matching images.
description.zh: 按模型规则配置壁纸和外观，并轮播匹配的图片。

description.en: Configure multiple metered accounts or token plans and query their balances from one dashboard.
description.zh: 配置多个按量计费账号或 Token 套餐，在同一看板查询余额。

description.en: Show your DeepSeek wallet balance at the foot of the sidebar, refreshed after each turn, with an animated change. Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; supports DSH 0.1.7 and 0.2.0 only.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，每轮结束后刷新，金额变化时有动画。需要 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，仅支持 DSH 0.1.7 和 0.2.0。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
description.zh: 调整过程细节、实时思考与最终回答的显示方式。

description.en: Hash-anchored read/edit/undo_last_edit tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Every line gets a unique 3-char hash (A-Za-z0-9) that stays stable across edits; stale or ambiguous anchors are rejected, never fuzzy-matched. Undo persists across restarts.
description.zh: 通过行哈希执行读取、编辑和撤销，拒绝过期或歧义锚点。

description.en: Better input experience for DeepSeek Harness: file-to-Markdown, local file input, prompt optimization, and voice input
description.zh: 提供文件转 Markdown、本地文件引用、提示词优化与语音输入。

description.en: Set reasoning effort and image-input support for third-party models right in the official Models page, with suggested settings from a built-in model knowledge base.
description.zh: 在官方「模型」页直接为第三方模型设置思考强度和图片输入支持，可根据内置模型知识库一键填入推荐配置。

description.en: Keep files, an editor, changes, tasks and side chat together in a per-conversation sidebar.
description.zh: 在每个会话的侧栏中查看文件、编辑器、变更、任务与旁聊。

description.en: Organize workspace navigation by disk paths with optional name-based grouping.
description.zh: 按磁盘目录组织工作区导航，并可启用名称分组。

description.en: Read video subtitles, select relevant material and produce daily digests and notifications.
description.zh: 读取视频字幕并筛选内容，生成日报与消息提醒。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Blender production, reconstruction, validation, and export plugin
description.zh: 在 DSH 中调用 Blender 制作、重建、检查和导出场景。

description.en: Apply light-adaptive color schemes and frosted-glass interface styling.
description.zh: 应用可自适应深浅模式的配色与磨砂玻璃界面。

description.en: Show the current model, account balance or subscription quota, and session or historical spending beneath the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示模型、余额或订阅额度，以及会话与历史费用。

description.en: Validate storyboard JSON and render vertical promotional videos locally with Remotion.
description.zh: 校验分镜 JSON，并通过 Remotion 在本地渲染竖版宣传视频。

description.en: Connect playwright-mcp and peekaboo-mcp for browser and desktop control, with dependency setup and connection diagnostics.
description.zh: 接入 playwright-mcp 与 peekaboo-mcp 操控浏览器和桌面，提供依赖安装与连接诊断。

description.en: Use a visible browser that the agent can automate and the user can take over.
description.zh: 使用可由 Agent 自动操作、也可由用户接管的可见浏览器。

description.en: View 2D and 3D CAD files and use parametric modeling and export tools from a conversation.
description.zh: 在会话中查看二维与三维 CAD 文件，并调用参数化建模与导出工具。

description.en: Create and preview CadQuery or ezdxf designs, and export STEP, STL or DXF using a local Python installation.
description.zh: 通过本地 Python 的 CadQuery 或 ezdxf 建模、预览，并导出 STEP、STL 或 DXF。

description.en: Connect CalDAV calendars to view, create, reschedule, and import events from DSH.
description.zh: 连接 CalDAV 日历，在会话中查看、创建和调整日程，并导入日历文件。

description.en: General-purpose calendar for the DSH right sidebar: month view with date selection, a list of the day's events, and today and week overviews; events are stored locally, and the agent can read and write via calendar_panel.
description.zh: 在侧栏月历中管理日程，查看当天及本周安排，支持 Agent 读写本地事件。

description.en: Calorie diary for the DSH right sidebar: a built-in food table auto-computes kcal from grams, logs by meal, and shows daily totals and goal progress; the agent can read and write via calorie_panel.
description.zh: 在侧栏记录饮食，按食物和重量计算热量，查看每日合计与目标进度，支持 Agent 读写。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, skills and tools per session and inspect their context loading state.
description.zh: 按会话管理 MCP 服务器、技能和工具，查看它们在上下文中的加载状态。

description.en: Query community plugin assessment records, evidence snapshots, and scoring rules through read-only DSH or MCP tools.
description.zh: 通过只读工具查询社区插件评估记录、证据快照与评分规范。

description.en: WeChat (iLink / ClawBot) channel for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 通过微信 iLink/ClawBot 接入 DSH 消息通道。

description.en: Fullscreen lightbox for chat images with zoom, pan, download and paging, a thumbnail grid with adjustable columns, TIFF/HEIC transcoding, and an image-delivery rule.
description.zh: 全屏查看会话图片，支持缩放、拖动、下载、翻页及缩略图网格，并转换 TIFF/HEIC 图片。

description.en: Import AI coding agent conversations as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 将 AI 编程助手聊天记录导入为可继续对话的 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Search archived chats, restore conversations and delete sessions safely.
description.zh: 搜索已归档的聊天、恢复会话，并安全地删除会话。

description.en: Add a task dashboard, interactive content cards, downloads and workbenches for memory, capabilities, usage and media.
description.zh: 提供任务面板、交互卡片和下载工具，以及记忆、能力、用量和媒体工作台。

description.en: Snapshot sessions, workspaces and configuration, compare changes and restore a checkpoint.
description.zh: 保存会话、工作区和配置快照，查看差异并一键回退。

description.en: Apply warm cream surfaces, terracotta accents, serif interface text and the Absolutely code palette.
description.zh: 应用暖米色界面、陶土橙强调色、衬线字体和 Absolutely 代码配色。

description.en: Four-source migration wizard: copy Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions — copy-only, approval-gated, idempotent
description.zh: 预览并复制多种编程助手的会话、记忆、技能与指令到 DSH。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop theme for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — ivory and warm-black canvases, the clay accent, a Claude-style model picker, permission segments and an account drawer.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页应用 Claude Code Desktop 风格，提供明暗配色、模型选择器与账户面板。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop theme for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI — visual & interaction overhaul
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页应用 Claude Code Desktop 风格主题，调整视觉与交互。

description.en: Inspect desktop screens and applications, then use approval-gated mouse and keyboard tools.
description.zh: 查看桌面画面与应用，使用需要审批的鼠标和键盘操作工具。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin: automatically sends a localized continue prompt when a request is interrupted by network errors or other non-human causes
description.zh: 在网络错误等非人工中断后自动发送继续提示。

description.en: Navigate back and forward between sessions and plugin panels, with confirmation before refreshing a running session.
description.zh: 在会话与插件面板之间后退、前进，刷新运行中的会话前先确认。

description.en: Browse a file tree and edit Markdown or text with tabs, preview, manual saving and drag-and-drop moves.
description.zh: 通过文件树和标签页编辑 Markdown 或文本，提供预览、手动保存和拖拽移动。

description.en: Quote selected text from chat, file previews or terminals, add comments and open side conversations or source locations.
description.zh: 引用对话、文件预览或终端中的选中文字，添加评论，打开侧边对话或跳回原文。

description.en: Adjust the client scrollbar width from the plugin settings, from 4 to 20 pixels.
description.zh: 在插件设置中统一调整客户端滚动条宽度，支持 4–20 像素。

description.en: Cursor-style AI code workbench for DSH: file tree, tabbed editing, syntax highlighting, quote/translate tags for the AI, docked or floating layout.
description.zh: 提供 Cursor 风格代码工作台，支持文件树、多标签编辑、高亮、引用和翻译，可停靠或悬浮。

description.en: ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, search, read_image URL support, and configurable GPT Image generation for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 接入 Codex，并提供搜索、看图与可配置生图工具。

description.en: Sign in with a ChatGPT account to use Codex models in DSH. Declares support up to DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 用 ChatGPT 账号登录，在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型。声明支持到 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Replace the reasoning-effort levels in the composer with a continuous Codex-style slider, colored by level.
description.zh: 把输入框里的推理档位换成 Codex 风格的连续滑条，每一档配色不同。

description.en: Connect eligible ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions through OAuth and view account quotas in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 接入 ChatGPT 与 Codex 订阅模型，并查看账户额度。

description.en: Hear what the agent is doing: generative background music while the model writes, plus adjustable cues for thinking, answering, tool runs, completion and waiting. Sounds are synthesized in the browser.
description.zh: 用声音盯住 Agent：模型输出时播放生成式背景音乐，思考、回答、工具执行以及完成、等待的提示音可分别调节。声音由浏览器实时合成。

description.en: Customize DSH colors with the Mariana palette, saved presets and contrast hints. The package does not declare a DSH compatibility range.
description.zh: 以 Mariana 为默认配色，调整界面与正文颜色、保存配色方案并查看对比度提示。包内未声明适用的 DSH 版本。

description.en: Run local or remote ComfyUI workflows with asset panels and per-workflow skills.
description.zh: 运行本机或远程 ComfyUI 工作流，管理素材面板与工作流技能。

description.en: DSH image generation plugin backed by a local ComfyUI server, exposing one unified generate_image tool (text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, background removal).
description.zh: 通过本机 ComfyUI 生成图片，支持文生图、图生图、局部重绘和背景移除。

description.en: DSH plugin: one uniform frosted-glass material for the UI surfaces, plus an optional image or video dynamic wallpaper behind them.
description.zh: 为界面应用统一磨砂玻璃效果，可搭配图片或视频壁纸。

description.en: Switch between Bottom, Right, and Automatic Composer layouts, with responsive sizing and space-aware controls.
description.zh: 把输入框放在底部、右侧，或根据可用空间自动调整布局。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness helpers that add 11 UI languages, a Changes panel, input history, Shift+Tab /plan, one-click Continue, and chat resumption after restart. They also add queue drag-and-drop and deeplinks.
description.zh: 提供多语言界面、变更面板、输入历史、计划模式和一键继续，支持重启后恢复会话及队列排序。

description.en: DSH web input enhancements: configurable send and newline keys, right-click menu, quick prompts stored in ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json, and prompt optimization with draft comparison.
description.zh: 调整发送与换行按键，提供右键菜单、快捷提示词和带草稿对比的提示词优化。

description.en: Use screenshots and vision models with virtual-mouse and desktop-operation tools.
description.zh: 结合截图与视觉模型，提供虚拟鼠标和桌面操作工具。

description.en: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP stdio server + PowerShell UIA backend, bridged into DSH via @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client. Read/act on real Windows desktop apps (UI Automation tree, screenshots, typed input, OCR, window management).
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation、截图、OCR 与 PowerShell 操作 Windows 应用。

description.en: Back up, restore, export, import, migrate and sync your complete DSH configuration: settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agent presets and workspaces.
description.zh: 备份、恢复、导入导出和同步 DSH 设置、插件、MCP、技能、预设与工作区，方便迁移到新机器。

description.en: Use Agnes in DSH with at-a-glance quota, models, and image and video tools; image recognition and thinking levels are auto-filled, and AgnesCode credentials are reused automatically.
description.zh: 接入 Agnes 模型和图片、视频工具，查看额度，并复用 AgnesCode 登录凭据。

description.en: Ask an authenticated local AtomCode CLI for workspace-scoped advice or bounded code reviews with structured findings.
description.zh: 调用本机已登录的 AtomCode，针对当前工作目录提供持续咨询和范围明确的代码评审。

description.en: Display ModelScope balance and request statistics, with optional registration of ModelScope models as a provider.
description.zh: 显示魔搭余额和调用统计，并可选择将魔搭模型注册为模型提供方。

description.en: Import free models from a local opencode serve catalog while keeping tool execution in DSH.
description.zh: 从本机 opencode serve 目录导入免费模型，并将工具执行留在 DSH。

description.en: SenseNova connect bundle for the Harness Web UI. It has a Token Plan credit panel with per-pool quota windows, per-model usage, and a self-renewing token, and can register SenseNova models as a provider.
description.zh: 接入 SenseNova 模型，查看 Token Plan 额度、各模型用量和配额周期，支持令牌自动续期。

description.en: Connect locally signed-in Trae models with separate domestic and international providers.
description.zh: 接入本机已登录的 Trae 模型，分别管理国内与国际供应商。

description.en: Connect locally signed-in WorkBuddy models and view account credits.
description.zh: 接入本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 模型，并查看账户积分。

description.en: Inspect context composition, changes and compression from a dashboard and command.
description.zh: 通过面板和命令查看上下文组成、变化与压缩情况。

description.en: Run code in subprocesses and return concise results, or index long material in local SQLite FTS5 for search.
description.zh: 在子进程执行代码并返回精简结果，或把长材料存入本地 SQLite FTS5 供检索。

description.en: Replace the compaction summarizer with a five-section handoff and keep compressed messages readable through a segmented directory.
description.zh: 用五部分交接文档生成压缩摘要，并提供分段目录，方便查看被压缩的消息。

description.en: Central SQLite memory and skill store partitioned by workspace: session-start index injection, gated explicit writes and proposal-based extraction, skills materialized as SKILL.md.
description.zh: 按工作区保存 SQLite 记忆与技能，启动会话时注入索引，写入前检查权限，并将技能保存为 SKILL.md。

description.en: Browse a collapsible turn-by-turn outline, jump to messages and track the current scroll position.
description.zh: 按轮次查看可折叠大纲，点击跳转并跟踪当前滚动位置。

description.en: Preview conversation deletion and optional linked-memory cleanup, with a recycle bin, audit log and per-session rollback.
description.zh: 预览会话及可选关联记忆的清理范围，提供回收站、审计日志和逐会话回滚。

description.en: Track session and daily model costs alongside account balances, budgets, and subscription usage.
description.zh: 统计会话与每日模型费用，显示账户余额、预算和订阅套餐用量。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and per-session usage cost in the Harness composer dock.
description.zh: 在输入框旁显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和各会话费用。

description.en: Manage CLIProxyAPI accounts, balances, check-ins and tasks, with automatic CPA startup and shutdown.
description.zh: 管理 CLIProxyAPI 账号、余额、签到与任务，并让 CPA 随 DSH 启停。

description.en: Track provider balances, plan quotas, session costs and spending across time ranges.
description.zh: 查看供应商余额、套餐额度、会话费用和不同时间范围的累计消耗。

description.en: Ctrl+wheel page zoom for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with an on-screen zoom chip and a General settings row.
description.zh: 通过 Ctrl+滚轮缩放网页，在界面中显示缩放比例，并提供通用设置项。

description.en: Edit custom CSS or configure wallpapers from the General settings page.
description.zh: 在通用设置中编辑自定义 CSS，或通过面板设置壁纸。

description.en: Load, edit, manage and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加载、编辑、管理可信的 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 用户脚本，并支持热重载。

description.en: Edit DSH custom modes, including the system prompt, base mode and plugin switches, and keep several assistants.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 自定义模式的系统提示词、基础模式和插件开关，可以创建多个助手。

description.en: User-editable CSS themes and background images for the DSH Web GUI and Desktop app, with pickers in Settings
description.zh: 在设置中选择或编辑 CSS 主题和背景图片，支持网页端与桌面端。

description.en: Adds macOS- and Windows-style interfaces, theme colors, wallpaper and font settings to DeepSeek Harness, plus a Blue Whale desktop pet that can be toggled independently.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 与 Windows 风格界面、主题配色、壁纸和字体设置，以及可独立开关的蓝鲸桌宠。

description.en: Track DeepSeek usage, costs and balance per call, session and account, with a whale-girl companion and damage-number animations for every charge.
description.zh: 按单次、会话和账户三层统计 DeepSeek 用量、费用和余额，每次扣费都有鲸娘和伤害数字式的动画反馈。

description.en: Profile, clean and verify structured datasets through deterministic tools.
description.zh: 用规则和工具分析、清理并核对结构化数据。

description.en: Structured decision layer for the DeepSeek Harness agent loop: a dangerous-call gate, output self-check, tool narrowing and loop guard, backed by a pluggable adjudication model.
description.zh: 在 Agent 执行过程中检查高风险调用、核对输出、限制工具范围，并检测重复循环。

description.en: Know when your DeepSeek Harness tasks need you. Local alerts, quiet notifications, and a task inbox.
description.zh: 通过本机提醒、通知与任务收件箱查看需要关注的会话。

description.en: DSH web plugin: monitors DeepSeek balance and platform usage, shown in the Models settings provider row and in the composer tool row to the left of the model name.
description.zh: 在模型设置和输入框工具栏显示 DeepSeek 余额与平台用量。

description.en: Use DeepSeek web chat and its API platform in DSH, and continue web chats as DSH sessions. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 desktop; persistent sign-in and downloads need the companion host adapter.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面内使用 DeepSeek 网页聊天与 API 平台，将网页会话转为 DSH 会话继续。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，持久登录与官网下载需配套宿主适配。

description.en: Apply detection rules to messages, tool arguments and results, with auditable allow, ask or block decisions.
description.zh: 对消息、工具参数与结果应用检测规则，记录允许、询问或阻止的决策。

description.en: Search and recall local session histories from other coding agents without an LLM indexer.
description.zh: 检索和召回其他编程助手的本地会话历史，无需模型建立索引。

description.en: Session manager for DeepSeek Harness: list, archive, unarchive and permanently delete sessions from a settings page.
description.zh: 在设置页列出、归档、恢复和永久删除会话。

description.en: Check overdue days against dates and free periods, and compare declared charges with days multiplied by rates.
description.zh: 按日期与免箱期核对超期天数，并比较填报费用与天数乘费率的结果。

description.en: Download, update and launch a desktop shell with shortcuts and a launch tool.
description.zh: 下载、更新并启动桌面外壳，创建快捷方式与启动工具。

description.en: Configure and reorder desktop status fields, with token costs, custom model prices, currencies and account balance.
description.zh: 配置和排序桌面状态字段，显示 Token 费用、自定义模型单价、币种和账户余额。

description.en: DSH plugin: configure per-model reasoning effort levels for custom pi-ai providers in the Models settings page, with presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo models.
description.zh: 在模型设置中调整第三方模型的推理强度，提供 GPT、Claude、Grok、GLM 和 MiMo 预设。

description.en: DSH plugin: inventory your Windows dev/test toolchain, spot the gaps, and fill them with one click.
description.zh: 检查 Windows 开发和测试工具链，找出并补齐缺失组件。

description.en: Store project knowledge in editable Markdown files shared across sessions in the same project.
description.zh: 将项目知识保存为可编辑的 Markdown 文件，供同一项目的多个会话共享。

description.en: Delivery quality gate for DeepSeek Harness: grill the requirements, test the implementation, prove the delivery, and gate the handoff with a deliverable/rework decision.
description.zh: 通过需求澄清、实现检查与交付证据决定交付或返工。

description.en: DPK manager for DeepSeek Harness: pack, verify and install local DSH plugin packages (.dpk) from the Plugins-page panel and the in-session dpk tool.
description.zh: 在插件页或会话中打包、校验和安装本地 .dpk 插件包。

description.en: Edit a sidebar canvas and read or update .drawio files through diagram tools.
description.zh: 在侧栏编辑画布，并通过语义绘图工具读写 .drawio 文件。

description.en: Switch between shareable themes with wallpapers, accent colors and translucent surfaces.
description.zh: 切换可分享的主题，调整壁纸、强调色与半透明界面。
