description.en: Show the DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer and configure it from the plugin page.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在插件页配置显示方式。

description.en: Register machines and delegate tasks to one or more of them through ACP-backed agent tools.
description.zh: 登记机器后，通过基于 ACP 的 Agent 工具向一台或多台机器派发任务。

description.en: Dictate into the composer, then polish the text through a dsh model before sending
description.zh: 通过语音在输入框录入文字，发送前可用模型润色；支持本地 Whisper 及云端识别服务。

description.en: Recall and re-edit messages in the web conversation.
description.zh: 撤回并重新编辑网页会话中的消息。

description.en: Inspect per-turn skill usage and manage installed skills and their upstream updates.
description.zh: 查看每轮技能调用，并管理已安装技能及其上游更新。

description.en: Drive browser automation tools and watch or interact with the live browser view.
description.zh: 调用浏览器自动化工具，并查看或操作实时浏览器画面。

description.en: Connect multiple mail accounts to send, receive, and search messages with attachments, drafts, and sending approvals.
description.zh: 连接多个邮箱，在会话中收发和搜索邮件，并管理附件、本地草稿与发信审批。

description.en: Use C/C++ firmware skills covering RTOS, interrupts, storage, debugging and architecture.
description.zh: 使用涵盖实时系统、中断、存储、调试和架构的 C/C++ 固件开发技能。

description.en: Add switchable inline emoji packs to agent replies, mapped from 40 semantic emoji without extra model calls, with adjustable frequency and size.
description.zh: 为 Agent 回复加入可切换的行内表情包，由 40 个语义表情映射而来，不额外调用模型，可调整出现频率和大小。

description.en: Curated long-term memory kept as plain Markdown notes and shared across hosts, with the index size limit enforced by a tool guard. Keep the store git-ignored when it sits inside a project repository.
description.zh: 以纯 Markdown 笔记保存的策展式长期记忆，多个宿主共用一个记忆库，索引上限由工具守卫强制执行。记忆库放在项目仓库内时需加入 git-ignore。

description.en: Rewrite the composer draft in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app with work, code and design modes, and restore the original text with one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的输入栏改写提示词，提供日常办公、代码开发和设计创意三种模式，支持一键还原原文。

description.en: Adds an Environment Check tab in Settings showing host process identity and grouped env vars (values stay on the host), plus a read-only env_inspect model tool.
description.zh: 在设置中查看宿主进程和环境变量分组，通过只读工具检查环境，变量值保留在宿主端。

description.en: Review tool requests that need to run outside the sandbox, retaining sandbox restrictions and denying automatic approval if review fails.
description.zh: 只复核需要在沙箱外执行的工具请求，保留原有沙箱限制；审查失败时不自动放行。

description.en: Check rubric fields, evidence locations, per-item score limits and agreement between item scores and totals.
description.zh: 核对评分项、原文定位、单项分值上限，以及各项得分与总分的算术一致性。

description.en: Host-side Cordis control plugin for aeval: a one-shot config injector for experiment variables, lease budgets, fork lineage and bundle descriptor, plus a status mode.
description.zh: 为 aeval 注入实验变量、执行预算和分支记录等配置，并提供状态查看模式。

description.en: Apply six Everforest light and dark palettes with three contrast levels and per-browser persistence.
description.zh: 提供六套 Everforest 明暗配色与三档对比度，并按浏览器保存选择。

description.en: Run role-based subagents in parallel with per-role model and reasoning settings and a task sidebar.
description.zh: 并行运行按角色配置的子 Agent，为各角色设置模型与思考深度，并提供任务侧栏。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one Feishu topic maps to one dsh session, with in-card approvals and questions over a long connection that needs no public endpoint.
description.zh: 通过飞书话题连接 DSH 会话，在卡片中审批和回答问题，无需公网入口。

description.en: Review DeepSeek Harness file changes in native sidebar tabs
description.zh: 在原生侧栏标签页中审阅工作区文件变更。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness dual-face plugin: Codex-style file references (@path), fully bundled document→Markdown (MarkItDown engine, 20+ formats), mature image handling (read_image for multimodal routes, automatic vision descriptions for text-only models), read_document tool.
description.zh: 上传和引用文件，将文档转为 Markdown，并提供图片与文档读取工具。

description.en: Finance terminal for the DSH right sidebar: cross-asset quotes, a rotating globe, a risk-appetite gauge, plain-Chinese explanations and related news, with two-way chat with the agent via finance_panel.
description.zh: 在侧栏查看多类资产行情、风险偏好指标、中文说明和资讯，并与 Agent 交流。

description.en: Convert Markdown to inline-styled WeChat articles, with themes, a sidebar workbench and block editing tools.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 排成带内联样式的公众号文章，提供主题、侧边工作台和块级改稿工具。

description.en: Visualize session execution, tool calls and concurrent agent branches.
description.zh: 可视化会话执行过程、工具调用与并发 Agent 分支。

description.en: Pop-out sidebar: a DeepSeek Harness sidebar that shows artifacts and pops out into a larger web tab.
description.zh: 在侧栏预览产物，也可弹出到独立浏览器标签页中放大查看。

description.en: Notify for approvals, questions, plan review and completed replies, accounting for window focus and background sessions.
description.zh: 根据窗口焦点和后台会话状态，提醒审批、提问、方案确认与回复完成。

description.en: Lets the DeepSeek Harness web composer accept folders via drag, paste or the /folder command, with a host folder dialog and @path mentions.
description.zh: 在网页输入框拖入、粘贴或选择文件夹，生成 @path 引用，也可使用 /folder 命令。

description.en: DIY your DSH UI fonts: per-region font, size, weight, and color for Chinese and English, pick-to-create regions, unified overrides, saved themes, random color schemes, and one-click install of cute fonts.
description.zh: 按区域调整中英文字体、字号、字重和颜色，保存主题，并支持随机配色和字体安装。

description.en: Adjust conversation, interface, and code typography and save, import, or export presets.
description.zh: 分别调整对话、界面和代码的字体样式，并保存、导入和导出排版预设。

description.en: Search and fetch pages through multiple engines with configurable routing, filters and fallbacks.
description.zh: 使用多个引擎搜索和抓取网页，自定义路由、筛选与失败切换。

description.en: Free-tier model aggregation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): registers a freeroute provider over a pool of free-quota upstreams such as OpenCode Zen, B.AI, OpenRouter and SenseNova.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen、B.AI、OpenRouter、SenseNova 等来源的免费额度模型汇总为一个供应商。

description.en: Encoding-aware read, write, edit and grep tools for DSH: keeps UTF-8 BOM and round-trips GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, Windows-1251 and UTF-16 bytes exactly.
description.zh: 读写、编辑和搜索多种编码的文件，保留 UTF-8 BOM，并支持 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS 等编码。

description.en: Turns DSH's settings dialog into a Codex-style full-page fullscreen settings page for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将设置弹窗改为 Codex 风格的全屏设置页。

description.en: Collect public fund data and inspect holdings, manager history and performance metrics.
description.zh: 整理公开基金数据，查看持仓、基金经理履历与业绩指标。

description.en: Generate game sprites, animation frames, maps, images and music through dedicated tools.
description.zh: 通过专用工具生成游戏精灵、动画帧、地图、图片与音乐。

description.en: Shows a Gemini quota bar in the DeepSeek Harness composer; clicking it opens a multi-account pool panel with per-account remaining quota, cooldown start/stop, keep-alive detection, and one-click account switching.
description.zh: 在输入框查看 Gemini 额度，展开面板后管理多账号、冷却状态和账号切换。

description.en: GenUI for DeepSeek Harness: interactive charts, forms, calculators, dashboards, and mini apps rendered inline in assistant replies, with actions that flow back to the model.
description.zh: 在回复中渲染图表、表单、计算器与小应用，并将操作反馈给模型。

description.en: Publish generated HTML or Markdown to GitHub Pages and manage previously published artifacts.
description.zh: 将生成的 HTML 或 Markdown 发布到 GitHub Pages，并管理已发布产物。

description.en: Import binaries and run decompilation and output operations through persistent PyGhidra and GhidraMCP servers.
description.zh: 通过持久运行的 PyGhidra 与 GhidraMCP 服务导入二进制、反编译并输出结果。

description.en: Show the session's repository, branch, change count and short SHA above the composer; switch or create branches, list worktrees and open a per-file diff panel.
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示当前会话的仓库、分支、改动数和短 SHA，可切换或新建分支、查看工作树，并在侧栏逐文件查看差异。

description.en: Git branch and worktree management: shows and switches the current branch in the input toolbar, with an IDEA-style branch picker, remote checkout, right-click actions, push/update, and isolated worktree workspaces.
description.zh: 在输入框切换和管理 Git 分支，支持远程分支、推送、更新，以及独立 Git 工作树。

description.en: Manage forge accounts and project authorization, then supply HTTPS credentials through a helper and reject unauthorized hosts.
description.zh: 管理代码托管账号和项目授权，通过凭据助手提供 HTTPS 认证，并拒绝未授权主机。

description.en: Long-term memory stored in a local Git repository, with a settings row to check its status and clear memories. Declares support only for DSH 0.1.
description.zh: 把长期记忆保存在本地 Git 仓库中，可在设置页查看状态并清除记忆。仅声明支持 DSH 0.1。

description.en: dsh panel plugin: sidebar git management — Local Changes / All Commits, branch/tag/stash management, merge with conflict handling.
description.zh: 在侧栏查看改动与提交，管理分支、标签和暂存记录，支持合并及冲突处理。

description.en: A Review tab and guarded git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: changes vs HEAD as a filterable file tree with per-file diffs, a commit graph, and stage/commit/branch actions.
description.zh: 按文件查看改动和差异，浏览提交图，执行暂存、提交和分支操作。

description.en: Git tools and /git slash commands for DeepSeek Harness, running git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work even when the session shell is sandboxed.
description.zh: 通过宿主进程执行 Git 和 /git 命令，即使会话 Shell 在沙箱中也可推送、拉取和获取更新。

description.en: Run a dedicated Git Bash executor and terminal integration on Windows.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上使用独立 Git Bash 命令执行器与终端集成。

description.en: A GitHub workflow engine for DeepSeek Harness with native GitHub CLI (gh) integration. It provides 18 agent tools for PRs, CI diagnosis, releases, secrets, rulesets, and Copilot dispatch, plus /gh shortcuts.
description.zh: 通过 gh 在 DSH 中管理 PR、排查 CI、发布版本，并操作密钥、规则集和 Copilot 任务。

description.en: Edit the user-global AGENTS.md ($DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md) from the web settings panel.
description.zh: 在网页设置面板中编辑用户全局的 AGENTS.md（$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md）。

description.en: Keep a shared cross-session todo list, hand tasks to a conversation and confirm agent-reported completion. The panel requires the DSH Web client.
description.zh: 跨会话管理人和 Agent 共用的待办清单，一键交给对话继续处理，并由人确认完成。界面需使用 DSH Web 客户端。

description.en: Gotify notifications when DSH session turns end: a host and browser plugin bundle, configurable in the Settings UI.
description.zh: 在会话轮次结束时发送 Gotify 通知，可在设置页配置。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for graph-based goal management and kanban visualization.
description.zh: 通过关系图与看板管理 Agent 目标。

description.en: Discover Grok models and run image, video and speech generation with durable local media tasks.
description.zh: 发现 Grok 模型，执行图片、视频和语音生成，并在本地持久化媒体任务。

description.en: Use a SuperGrok or X Premium Grok Build subscription in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 的 Grok Build 订阅。

description.en: Summarize running, approval, completion and scheduled-task states on collapsed sidebar groups, with counts and hover details.
description.zh: 在收起的侧栏分组上汇总运行、审批、完成和定时任务状态，显示数量与悬停明细。

description.en: Track your DeepSeek Harness coding time on Hackatime (WakaTime-compatible heartbeats).
description.zh: 将 DSH 编码时长记录到 Hackatime，兼容 WakaTime 心跳协议。

description.en: A library for patching, replacing and decorating DeepSeek Harness plugins during runtime
description.zh: 在 DSH 运行时修改、替换或扩展插件行为。

description.en: Connect Kimi models to native DSH sessions and choose an embedded Kimi core or DSH execution per model.
description.zh: 在原生 DSH 会话中接入 Kimi 模型，按模型选择内嵌 Kimi 核心或 DSH 执行方式。

description.en: Check worksheet fields and consistency between process parameters, guide words and declared deviations.
description.zh: 核对 HAZOP 表的要素，以及工艺参数、引导词与所填偏差的一致性。

description.en: DSH-native HarmonyOS dev assistant: hdc device debugging, an input-row development panel, official-first versioned API docs, DevEco compile assistance, and standalone Command Line Tools support.
description.zh: 接入 hdc 设备调试、版本化 API 文档和 DevEco 编译辅助。

description.en: Load a Herta persona preset with memory and voice tools, bundled voice clips and character-specific conversation views.
description.zh: 加载黑塔角色预设，提供记忆与语音工具、随包语音及专属对话视图。

description.en: Search conversations within projects, read rendered history and export session content locally.
description.zh: 按项目搜索会话、阅读渲染后的历史内容，并在本地导出对话。

description.en: Human-in-the-loop gate for DSH tool calls: mount any tool behind an approve, modify or reject decision card in the DSH web UI, with an optional countdown.
description.zh: 在工具执行前显示人工确认卡片，可批准、修改或拒绝，并可设置倒计时。

description.en: Ask DSH to set up home services such as Gitea or Jellyfin in home-hosted, and manage the panel, entries and boot autostart. Nothing is installed or started until you confirm.
description.zh: 让 DSH 在 home-hosted 中搭建 Gitea、Jellyfin 等家庭服务，并管理面板、服务条目和开机自启。确认之前不会安装或启动任何服务。

description.en: Check chapter, heading and subheading prefixes against declared commodity codes, reporting structural differences.
description.zh: 核对章、品目、子目与商品编号的前缀和层级关系，提示结构差异。

description.en: Record sessions in Hypatia and recall relevant material for later conversations.
description.zh: 自动把会话记录进 Hypatia，并在后续对话中召回相关内容。

description.en: Japanese locale pack for the DSH Web GUI: registers 日本語 and provides ja dictionaries for all dsh-web-all family plugin namespaces.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面及 dsh-web-all 系列插件提供日语翻译。

description.en: The core Japanese locale pack for the DSH Web GUI. It registers Japanese and provides ja dictionaries for every DSH core plugin namespace, independent of dsh-i18n-ja, with English fallback for missing keys.
description.zh: 为 DSH 核心界面提供独立日语语言包，缺少翻译时显示英文。

description.en: An IDE-grade Git tool window for DSH, mounted as a native dsh-better-sidebar tab. It offers a branch tree, commit graph, changes, commit details, and JetBrains-style actions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏使用 IDE 风格 Git 面板，查看分支、提交图和改动，支持 JetBrains 风格操作。

description.en: Compact sessions when context exceeds a token threshold and user inactivity reaches the configured duration.
description.zh: 上下文超过 Token 阈值且用户空闲达到配置时长后，自动压缩会话。

description.en: Inspect assistant presence across workspaces and move assistants between workspaces.
description.zh: 查看各工作区助手是否在线，并通过拖拽调整助手所属工作区。

description.en: Connect DSH to WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp and more than 25 channels, with unified sessions, remote approvals and interactive questions.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接入微信、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Telegram、Discord、Slack、WhatsApp 等 25 个以上渠道，统一会话路由，支持远程审批和交互提问。

description.en: Connect image-generation providers and local ComfyUI to the conversation.
description.zh: 在会话中接入多家图片生成供应商与本地 ComfyUI。

description.en: Image generation tool and settings page for DeepSeek Harness, working with any OpenAI-compatible /images/generations endpoint.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的图像生成工具与设置页，可对接任何兼容 OpenAI 的 /images/generations 接口。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: lets text-only models receive pasted images and analyze them with a built-in OpenAI-compatible vision tool.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型接收粘贴的图片，再调用兼容 OpenAI 接口的视觉工具分析。

description.en: Shows oversized images to the model at a readable high resolution by tiling them before admission.
description.zh: 将超大图片分块后提供给模型，保留可辨识的细节。

description.en: Zoom, browse, download, and annotate image regions in the DSH conversation viewer.
description.zh: 为会话图片提供缩放、多图浏览、原图下载和区域标注。

description.en: Collect public-source industry and company evidence, map industry chains and draft research reports.
description.zh: 整理公开行业与公司证据，绘制产业链并编写研究报告。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin: the model draws vector figures inline between reply paragraphs, so answers read as text, figure, text.
description.zh: 让模型在回复段落之间插入矢量图示，结合文字解释内容。

description.en: IRC client in DSH's right sidebar: the host connects to IRC directly via Node tls/net (or optionally through a local proxy's HTTP CONNECT tunnel), and agents can also read and send messages via the irc_panel tool.
description.zh: 在侧栏收发 IRC 消息，支持直连或本地代理，也可通过 Agent 工具读写。

description.en: Millisecond System-1 judgement for every tool call in DeepSeek Harness: Jev-powered risk classification and evidence-gated auto-approval, fail-closed by construction.
description.zh: 用 Jev 判断工具调用风险，根据检查结果和授权证据处理自动审批。

description.en: Display background task progress, processing speed and estimated remaining time in a floating panel.
description.zh: 在悬浮面板中显示后台任务进度、处理速度和预计剩余时间。

description.en: Apply the Joi Flowers or Joi Library fan theme to the web interface.
description.zh: 为网页界面应用 Joi Flowers 或 Joi Library 同人主题。

description.en: Edit and search notes, tasks and documents, with tables, attachments, export and agent collaboration.
description.zh: 编辑和搜索笔记、待办与文档，支持表格、附件、导出和 Agent 协作。

description.en: Daily journal and calendar for DeepSeek Harness: the journal_record tool appends one JSON file per day, and the right sidebar draws it as a calendar.
description.zh: 记录每日日记，按天保存在 JSON 文件中，并在右侧栏日历中查看。

description.en: Block Git commands inside Jujutsu workspaces and suggest the corresponding jj commands.
description.zh: 在 Jujutsu 工作区中阻止 Git 命令，并提示对应的 jj 命令。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin bundling the kimi-ppt skill: create, edit and export PPT slides and presentations as local .pptx files with Pillow-rendered previews.
description.zh: 通过 kimi-ppt 技能创建、编辑和导出本地 .pptx 演示文稿，提供图片预览。

description.en: Connect Kimi Code subscription models using API keys or device sign-in, with web search and quota displays.
description.zh: 接入 Kimi Code 订阅模型，支持设备登录、网页搜索和额度查询。

description.en: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — dynamic Cordis plugin source (host + client halves) plus an installable dsh bundle, with wallpaper/logo assets
description.zh: 为网页界面添加《你的名字》主题与壁纸素材。

description.en: Kingdee Cloud Starry Sky secondary-development plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): typed tools over the Kingdee Cloud WebAPI, credential-safe config, and a companion domain skill.
description.zh: 通过金蝶云 WebAPI 进行云星空二次开发，提供配套工具、凭据配置和领域技能。

description.en: Search and read local ZIM collections through a user-run kiwix-serve service, and list available books.
description.zh: 通过自行运行的 kiwix-serve 搜索和阅读本地 ZIM 资料，并列出可用书库。

description.en: Context retrieval for DeepSeek Harness: ranks docs, code and media by relevance into a sidebar Context Pack. Lexical and fully local by default. Hybrid is off until you configure a provider; it sends your query and file titles/summaries, not bodies.
description.zh: 按当前任务检索文档、代码与媒体，在侧栏整理相关资料；默认本地运行，混合检索需另行配置。

description.en: Cherry Studio-style knowledge base system for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): bases, documents, chunking, embeddings (OpenAI-compatible / Ollama / local / lexical fallback), retrieval, model-facing tools, and a browser management panel
description.zh: 管理文档、分块与向量检索，并通过工具和面板查询知识库。

description.en: Generate or edit images with Labnana and view subscription balances and estimated credit use.
description.zh: 通过 Labnana 生成或编辑图片，并查看订阅余额和积分用量估算。

description.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness — QR one-click auth, multi-mode agents, card-based commands, zero-loss outbox, media in/out, session logs, reusable DSH Web GUI
description.zh: 通过扫码登录、卡片命令与媒体消息连接飞书和 DSH。

description.en: Schedule reminders or delayed messages from commands and a panel, with delivery handled by the host.
description.zh: 通过命令或面板安排提醒和延迟消息，由宿主负责到时投递。

description.en: Leafy: an eye-friendly green skin that folds the DSH Web GUI's --dsw-* palette into leafy greens, in both light and dark modes.
description.zh: 应用 Leafy 绿色主题，支持浅色与深色模式。

description.en: Ledger for the DSH right sidebar: log entries (amount, category, note), view monthly totals and category stats; data stays local, and the agent can read and write via ledger_panel.
description.zh: 在侧栏记账，按月和分类查看收支，数据保存在本机，Agent 也可读写记录。

description.en: Show DeepSeek session costs and balance alongside Grok weekly quota, keeping gateway credentials in the host.
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek 会话费用与余额、Grok 本周剩余额度，网关凭据保存在宿主端。

description.en: Index local documents for hybrid search, context retrieval and citation checks.
description.zh: 为本地文档建立索引，进行混合检索、上下文召回与引用检查。

description.en: One settings card for the iLife suite (memo, calories, cooking, home, schedule and bookkeeping), with a read-only config check and an update panel. Each skill is installed separately.
description.zh: 爱生活系列的统一设置卡，汇集备忘录、卡路里、私家大厨、居家管家、作息管家和记账六个技能，附只读配置体检和更新面板。各技能需单独安装。

description.en: Lingxi (灵犀) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a desktop cat that reacts to the mood of the work, with five model tools (task, say, react, state, remember) over the pet bridge, plus settings.
description.zh: 添加会随工作状态反应的灵犀桌面猫，可通过工具安排任务、说话、切换状态和保存记忆。

description.en: Live2D pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a characterful agent companion — follows session state, switchable personas, bring-your-own models
description.zh: 添加随会话状态变化的 Live2D 角色，支持人设与自有模型。

description.en: A full-featured CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) provider plugin.
description.zh: 功能完整的 CodeBuddy（WorkBuddy）提供方插件。

description.en: Connect ChatGPT subscription models using locally stored Codex CLI sign-in credentials.
description.zh: 复用本机 Codex CLI 登录凭据，为 DSH 接入 ChatGPT 订阅模型。

description.en: Configurable DSH-native LLM verifier with a Web settings page
description.zh: 通过网页设置配置 DSH 原生模型验证器。

description.en: Manage LobsterAI accounts from a draggable floating panel, with built-in balance, check-in and account-switching controls.
description.zh: 通过可拖动悬浮面板管理 LobsterAI 账号，提供内置余额查询、签到和账号切换。

description.en: Local-model (Ollama) integration for DeepSeek Harness: discover, pull, remove, and inspect local models, route requests to them by task type or keyword with automatic fallback to the cloud, and get a one-shot status overview via /ollama.
description.zh: 发现和管理本地模型，按任务路由调用，并可回退到云端模型。

description.en: Authorize a browser-local directory and let agent tools read or write it through a private WebSocket relay.
description.zh: 在浏览器授权本地目录，通过私有 WebSocket 通道让 Agent 工具读写其中的文件。

description.en: DSH plugin: start and stop a local llama.cpp llama-server from Settings → Plugins, with two model slots (A/B), per-slot model-file selection, and eight editable launch parameters.
description.zh: 在插件设置中启动或停止本机 llama.cpp 服务，支持两个模型配置和启动参数调整。

description.en: Password gate: when DSH opens, a password screen appears first, and the app is usable only after unlocking. Supports manual and automatic locking, with passwords stored as one-way scrypt hashes.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加密码锁屏，支持手动与自动锁定，密码以 scrypt 哈希保存。

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints, and rename tools over language servers, plus the editor action protocol (lsp.actions.*) that makes the plugin the IDE integration backend
description.zh: 通过语言服务器执行诊断、格式化、补全、符号查询和重命名。

description.en: Map and routing tools for DeepSeek Harness: driving, transit, walking, and cycling route planning, geocoding, reverse geocoding, and POI search via Amap (高德) or free OSM/OSRM.
description.zh: 通过高德或 OSM/OSRM 查询地点，规划驾车、公交、步行和骑行路线。

description.en: An Obsidian side-panel math memory agent for DeepSeek Harness. It offers layered long-term memory, an idea memo with proactive review reminders, and unified note_recall retrieval with note tools.
description.zh: 在 Obsidian 侧栏保存数学记忆和灵感备忘，支持复习提醒、统一检索和笔记工具。

description.en: Bundle the 27 engineering and productivity skills from mattpocock/skills and turn the work into a task board backed by GitHub issues. Managing labels needs write access to the repository.
description.zh: 内置 mattpocock/skills 的 27 个工程与效率技能，并把任务做成基于 GitHub Issue 的看板。创建和流转标签需要仓库写权限。

description.en: The execution maze for DeepSeek Harness agents: see how the agent actually worked — main path, detours and backtracks on one timeline, with data tracks, deterministic analysis, and multi-session comparison
description.zh: 在时间线上查看任务路径、绕行与回退，并比较多个会话。

description.en: Manage MCP servers visually and discover or load tools on demand.
description.zh: 可视化管理 MCP 服务器，并按需检索和加载工具。

description.en: Universal MCP Apps host and UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 在 DSH 中运行 MCP Apps，显示工具提供的交互界面。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness MCP Connector: connect servers, search tools across active connections, and troubleshoot discovery. Includes a continuously updated catalog; supports OAuth 2.0 PKCE, API keys, Streamable HTTP/stdio, and mcpServers JSON import.
description.zh: 连接 MCP 服务器，跨连接查找工具，并排查工具未被识别等问题。

description.en: Inspect and edit profile MCP servers, manage connections and add servers from the official registry.
description.zh: 查看和编辑当前配置中的 MCP 服务器，管理连接，并从官方目录添加服务器。

description.en: Context7 MCP for DeepSeek Harness: up-to-date library documentation and code examples.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Context7 MCP：提供最新的库文档与代码示例。

description.en: Firecrawl MCP for DeepSeek Harness: web crawling, scraping, search, and structured data extraction
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Firecrawl MCP：网页爬取、抓取、搜索和结构化数据提取

description.en: Parse pasted or imported MCP configurations, preview risk notes and write selected servers into the current profile.
description.zh: 解析粘贴或导入的 MCP 配置，展示风险提示，将选定服务器写入当前配置。

description.en: MCP manager settings page for DeepSeek Harness: list, enable, configure and add MCP servers from the browser, written durably to the profile's user patch layer.
description.zh: 在网页设置中添加、配置和开关 MCP 服务器，配置保存到当前 Profile。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, inspect health and try tool pipelines from the interface or command.
description.zh: 通过界面或命令管理 MCP 服务器、检查状态并试运行工具管道。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills in one panel: add, edit and remove MCP entries, import settings from other agents, and embed the plugin market when dshmarket is installed. Works in Web and Desktop.
description.zh: 在一个面板里管理 MCP 服务和技能：增删改 MCP 条目、导入其他 Agent 的配置；安装 dshmarket 时内嵌插件市场。Web 和桌面端通用。

description.en: Media panel in the DSH right sidebar: downloads Douyin/YouTube links with yt-dlp, converts audio to 16 kHz mono WAV with ffmpeg, and transcribes it with the official speechToText (SenseVoice) for subtitles and agent summaries.
description.zh: 用本机 yt-dlp 下载抖音或 YouTube 媒体，经 ffmpeg 和 SenseVoice 转录为字幕，并供 Agent 总结。

description.en: One-click meme picker in the composer, plus a searchable multi-pack library: install packs from the marketplace, filter by mood or keyword, and let the model learn new images.
description.zh: 在输入框挑选表情包，按情绪或关键词搜索，支持图库安装、导入导出和图片学习。

description.en: Keep layered cross-session memories in local SQLite with retrieval, write approvals, and context injection.
description.zh: 以本地 SQLite 保存分层跨会话记忆，提供检索、写入审批和上下文注入。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: multi-channel retrieval and an evolving memory store.
description.zh: 通过多通道检索维护和召回长期记忆。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) local-first cross-session project memory: bounded cache-friendly Hot Memory, BM25 recall/cache, provenance, lifecycle and bilingual Web GUI; no embeddings, external service or bundled runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 用本地热记忆、BM25 检索与来源记录保存跨会话项目知识。

description.en: Ports WorkBuddy's file-based memory system into DeepSeek Harness: human-readable Markdown memory at user level and per workspace (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md and <cwd>/.deepseek-harness/memory/).
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 的文件记忆方式接入 DSH，用 Markdown 保存用户级和工作区级记忆。

description.en: Render Mermaid diagrams on demand, follow the current theme and open a fullscreen zoom viewer.
description.zh: 按需渲染 Mermaid 图表，适配当前主题，并提供全屏缩放查看。

description.en: Build usage and estimated-spend views from session event logs, with model, time, project and conversation filters.
description.zh: 从会话事件日志汇总用量与费用估算，支持按模型、时间、项目和会话筛选。

description.en: Composable memory with pluggable sources and strategies for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可组合记忆、可插拔来源与记忆策略。

description.en: Cap how many characters Mnemon memory may add to each turn. An optional add-on for Mnemon strategies; a very small cap can hide memories.
description.zh: 限制 Mnemon 记忆每轮注入上下文的字符数，是 Mnemon 主策略的可选扩展。上限设得过小可能漏掉记忆。

description.en: Choose which Mnemon memory sources a strategy reads and which ones it may write. An optional add-on for Mnemon strategies.
description.zh: 指定 Mnemon 主策略读取哪些记忆来源、允许写入哪些，是 Mnemon 的可选扩展。

description.en: Use DSH on your computer from a phone browser or the Android app over LAN or optional remote tunnels (Tailscale, cpolar, cloudflared, FRP), with HTTPS and device pairing.
description.zh: 通过局域网或可选的远程通道（Tailscale、cpolar、cloudflared、FRP），用手机浏览器或 Android App 安全地使用电脑上的 DSH，支持 HTTPS 和设备配对。

description.en: One-click context window matching and selective bulk configuration for DeepSeek Harness models, with source references and manual management.
description.zh: 按参考来源匹配模型上下文窗口，并选择性批量配置。

description.en: Fusion for DeepSeek Harness: one model entry backed by a frontier Lead that reads, briefs and reviews, and a much cheaper Sidekick that writes the code.
description.zh: 由主模型阅读资料、规划和复核，让成本较低的副模型编写代码。

description.en: Import provider models, fill missing metadata from models.dev and override model fields or pricing.
description.zh: 导入供应商模型，从 models.dev 补充缺失参数，并覆盖模型字段或计价设置。

description.en: Adds thinking levels to third-party models in DSH, with a Thinking toggle and intensity/modality editor on the Models page and a provider-to-model picker in the composer. It also takes over request headers and user-agent per route.
description.zh: 为第三方模型设置思考强度和图片输入，可按模型配置请求头与 User-Agent。

description.en: Configure capabilities, plugins and system prompts per mode, with previews, version history and approval-gated prompt editing.
description.zh: 按模式配置能力、插件和系统提示词，提供预览、历史版本与需审批的提示词编辑。

description.en: Readable conversational UI, interactive HTML/SVG, editable motion and local MP4 production for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 提供可读会话界面、交互 HTML/SVG、动画编辑与本机视频制作。

description.en: Parse motor design requirements and filter candidate parameters for downstream calculation tools.
description.zh: 解析电机设计需求，初筛候选参数并生成后续计算工具所需数据。

description.en: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg backgrounds with embedded video, scheduled switching, blur and a local rotation library.
description.zh: 加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 背景，支持内嵌视频、时段切换、虚化和本地轮换库。

description.en: Multi2API account pool: turns multiple WorkBuddy accounts into separate, non-interfering models in DSH.
description.zh: 管理多个 WorkBuddy 账号，在 DSH 中分别作为独立模型使用。

description.en: Play music alongside coding conversations.
description.zh: 在编程会话中使用音乐播放功能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness notification center: a tab-title whale status light (green = done / amber = pending) plus browser system notifications for completion and pending items, with 45 optional opencode sound effects and configurable volume.
description.zh: 用标签页状态灯、浏览器通知和提示音提醒任务完成或等待处理。

description.en: Desktop, browser and webhook notifications when the agent finishes a turn, hits an error or waits for approval.
description.zh: Agent 完成回合、出错或等待审批时，通过桌面、浏览器或 Webhook 提醒你。

description.en: Send native desktop notifications or webhooks when tasks complete, fail or wait for confirmation.
description.zh: 在任务完成、失败或等待确认时发送桌面原生通知或 Webhook 消息。

description.en: Send notifications through 28 outbound channels and handle approvals, questions and session control from your phone through 6 inbound channels.
description.zh: 通过 28 个出站渠道推送通知，并经 6 个入站渠道在手机上处理审批、回答提问和控制会话。

description.en: Show desktop or webhook notifications for task completion, questions and approvals.
description.zh: 为任务完成、提问和审批发送桌面或 Webhook 通知。

description.en: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, using the official Notion MCP with no integration token.
description.zh: 在界面中通过 OAuth 连接官方 Notion MCP，无需另填集成令牌。

description.en: Manage chapter drafting, setting constraints, repetition checks and whole-book reviews.
description.zh: 管理章节写作、设定约束、重复检查、批量起草与全书复核。

description.en: Manage chapter references, narrative continuity, revision checks and writing materials.
description.zh: 管理章节参考、叙事连贯性、改稿检查与创作素材。

description.en: Check application structure and potential identity disclosures in document text and metadata using supplied rosters and rules.
description.zh: 依据提供的名单和规则，核对基金申请结构及正文、文档属性中的潜在身份泄露。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness (dsh) to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes.
description.zh: 搜索、读取、编辑、移动和删除本机 Obsidian 笔记。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness pill showing whether the selected DeepSeek or z.ai billing plan is in a peak or off-peak (half-price) window right now, with a click-to-open schedule panel.
description.zh: 显示当前 DeepSeek 或 z.ai 套餐所处的峰谷计费时段，点击查看时段表。

description.en: Create and read documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in the session workspace, and update documents and spreadsheets.
description.zh: 在会话工作区中创建和读取文档、表格与演示文稿，并更新文档和表格。

description.en: Use an authenticated Claude Code CLI as a model provider, forwarding sessions, approvals and image input.
description.zh: 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 接为模型提供方，转发会话、审批和图片输入。

description.en: A typed, inference-capable ontology (TBox + ABox) plugin for DeepSeek Harness — durable domain knowledge the agent can define, assert against, and query under schema constraints.
description.zh: 用类型和规则定义领域知识，保存事实并进行查询和推理。

description.en: Manage OpenCode Go models and multiple accounts with subscription quota displays in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 OpenCode Go 模型与多个账号，并显示订阅额度。

description.en: DSH plugin: standalone OpenCode GO LlmAdapter that owns its provider route, with per-model wire protocols (including union-alpha's anthropic-messages), and manages models, context and modalities.
description.zh: 独立接入 OpenCode Go，为不同模型设置通信协议，管理上下文和输入类型。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: OpenCode GO plan quota widget in the sidebar, same-origin usage proxy, and a /opencode-go chat command
description.zh: 在侧栏显示 OpenCode Go 套餐额度，支持通过 /opencode-go 查询。

description.en: Apply a collection of persistent color themes to the web interface.
description.zh: 为网页界面应用多套可持久保存的主题配色。

description.en: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness: session affinity, Zen/Go gateway origin headers, free-tier tool fallback, and live Go quota display.
description.zh: 接入 OpenCode Zen/Go，保持会话与网关的对应关系，提供免费档工具调用回退和 Go 额度显示。

description.en: OpenRouter Provider List sets provider and quantization limits for OpenRouter requests, injected as provider.only, provider.order, and provider.quantizations. It can optionally route through billion-context.
description.zh: 设置 OpenRouter 请求使用的上游供应商、调用顺序和量化规格，可经 billion-context 转发。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows what the OpenRouter account actually charged today, per chat and in total, under the composer and in Settings, split by model and API key.
description.zh: 显示 OpenRouter 今日和各会话的实际扣费，按模型与 API 密钥查看明细。

description.en: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
description.zh: 在 OpenViking Studio 面板管理记忆，在会话中查看记忆保存记录和检索内容。

description.en: Configure the OpenViking memory plugin, diagnose connections and tune session recall scope and injection settings.
description.zh: 配置 OpenViking 记忆插件、诊断连接，并调整会话召回范围和注入参数。

description.en: Manage novel outlines, characters, annotations and review workflows with writing presets and a local Python backend.
description.zh: 管理小说大纲、人物、正文批注和审稿流程，提供创作预设及本地 Python 后端。

description.en: Provide Bash, PowerShell 7 and Rust-based command tools for DSH on Windows.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 Bash、PowerShell 7 和 Rust 命令工具。

description.en: Drives local Origin/OriginPro from chat: imports data, plots, fits, exports images and saves editable .opju projects; 27 MCP tools. Third-party, unaffiliated with OriginLab.
description.zh: 在对话中操作本机 Origin/OriginPro，导入数据、绘图、拟合和导出，并保存可编辑的 .opju 工程。

description.en: Control OriginLab data import, scientific plot templates and figure edits through MCP tools.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 工具操作 OriginLab 数据导入、科研图模板与图表编辑。

description.en: Use PackyCode API keys in DeepSeek Harness, with multi-protocol models, image generation and editing, separate key rings, and balance display.
description.zh: 通过 PackyCode API 接入多协议模型和图片生成、编辑工具，管理密钥与余额。

description.en: Paoding: an installer for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) orchestration mode, with host-aware role tool filtering and a visual configurator on the Web settings page.
description.zh: 安装庖丁编排模式，在网页中配置角色，并按宿主环境筛选各角色可用工具。

description.en: dsh-passwords: a server-grade gateway that turns DeepSeek Harness into a multi-tenant platform — remote access + automatic HTTPS, per-subuser permissions & quotas, sandbox enforcement, first-run setup, SQLite auth with at-rest encryption, rate-limit and audit log (bilingual zh/en UI)
description.zh: 为远程访问配置登录、用户权限、配额、HTTPS 与审计日志。

description.en: Pause before the next model request so the user can add instructions and continue manually.
description.zh: 在下一次模型请求前暂停，允许用户补充文字并手动继续。

description.en: Parse documents with MinerU cloud or self-hosted providers, using background jobs, cached results and shared requests.
description.zh: 通过 MinerU 云端或自托管服务解析文档，支持后台任务、产物缓存和请求合并。

description.en: Minimal Root-Orchestrator PTES pentesting plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 按 PTES 渗透测试流程组织任务，提供主 Agent 统筹的编排预设。

description.en: Define allow, deny and ask rules for tools, arguments, workspace paths and network targets.
description.zh: 按工具、参数、工作区路径与网络目标配置允许、拒绝和询问规则。

description.en: Import, switch and manage bundled or custom conversation personas.
description.zh: 导入、切换和管理内置或自定义会话人设。

description.en: Inspect token usage, costs and session state, and configure personal preferences.
description.zh: 集中查看 Token 用量、费用、会话状态并调整个人偏好。

description.en: A lazy blue fish living in DeepSeek Harness: plays with a Rubik's cube, snacks, naps, roams the desktop, tracks your balance wallet, and chats when idle.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中添加蓝色鱼形桌宠，会玩魔方、吃零食、打盹和聊天，并显示账户余额。

description.en: A Live2D pet docked in the DSH interface: she follows the pointer, reacts to clicks and changes expressions with each session phase, with configurable motions, expressions and lines.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面添加 Live2D 桌宠，随鼠标、点击和会话状态切换动作、表情与台词。

description.en: Show session events through a sticker companion, status bubbles and a desktop window.
description.zh: 用贴纸角色、状态气泡与桌面浮窗反映会话事件。

description.en: Notify for approvals, questions, completed work and errors through desktop alerts, sounds, title markers and webhooks.
description.zh: 通过桌面通知、声音、标题标记和 Webhook 提醒审批、提问、任务完成及错误。

description.en: Browse, search and install community plugins inside DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中浏览、搜索并安装社区插件。

description.en: Multi-directory workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多目录工作区。

description.en: Operate an Android emulator in a native DSH sidebar, with configurable APK, package, activity and monorepo paths. Flutter debug APKs hot-reload on Dart save; plain APKs can turn Flutter off. Requires an existing APK, a running emulator, the Android SDK and scrcpy 3.3.3; verified on a Windows emulator.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生侧栏中操作 Android 模拟器，可配置 APK、包名、Activity 与 monorepo 源码目录。Flutter 调试包保存 Dart 文件即热重载，普通 APK 可关闭 Flutter 模式。需已有 APK、运行中的模拟器、Android SDK 与 scrcpy 3.3.3，已在 Windows 模拟器上验证。

description.en: Previewable cross-preset session migration for DeepSeek Harness with bounded, fixed-schema handoffs
description.zh: 预览并生成结构化交接资料，在不同预设之间迁移会话。

description.en: BuilderHUD — vitals-cluster skins for the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 为侧栏添加 BuilderHUD 状态皮肤，显示仪表、徽章和实时 Token 消耗。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) settings cards and conversation node plugin.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供设置卡片和会话节点组件。

description.en: Release Console adds a DeepSeek Harness sidebar entry and main-panel page showing each repository's builds and releases. It flags whether local checkouts are ahead or installed copies are outdated.
description.zh: 在侧栏和主面板查看各仓库构建、发布和安装版本，识别待发布改动及过期安装。

description.en: Give the agent tools to find where a symbol is declared, what calls it and what a change reaches, from a local tree-sitter index.
description.zh: 基于本地 tree-sitter 索引，让 Agent 查询符号在哪里定义、被谁调用，以及改动会影响到哪里。

description.en: Development dashboard: embeds the control-your-development product dashboard into the DSH right sidebar and session page.
description.zh: 将 control-your-development 的项目开发面板嵌入 DSH 侧栏和会话页。

description.en: Inspect plugin runtime behavior and distinguish live configuration changes, restarts and hot reloads.
description.zh: 诊断插件运行状态，区分实时配置生效、重启和热重载。

description.en: Chat with DSH sessions through Discord messages or threads and answer approvals or questions from either interface.
description.zh: 通过 Discord 私信或线程连接 DSH 会话，并可在任一界面回答审批或提问。

description.en: A TypeScript-based Garmin Connect plugin and MCP server with secure browser-based MFA for DeepSeek Harness and other AI agents
description.zh: 通过插件与 MCP 服务连接 Garmin Connect 账户。

description.en: Let the agent build a focused React page for the task at hand and carry the user's choices into the next turn. Web profile only.
description.zh: 让 Agent 为当前任务生成专用的 React 页面，并把用户在页面上的选择带入下一轮。仅支持 Web。

description.en: One-call Conventional Commits Git workflow for DeepSeek Harness at zero token cost: generates commit messages for each changed file, splits them into commits by type(scope), pushes once, and asks about tagging when needed.
description.zh: 按 Conventional Commits 规则生成提交信息、拆分提交并统一推送，必要时询问是否打标签。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin-development knowledge base: official docs mirror, contract rules, migration guide, verified issue index, and the dsh-plugin-dev CLI.
description.zh: 提供 DSH 插件开发文档、接口规则、迁移指南、问题索引和 dsh-plugin-dev 命令行工具。

description.en: Turn any markdown, local folder, or GitHub learning repo into a guided course inside DeepSeek Harness: gated skill-tree progression, BKT mastery tracking, SM-2 spaced repetition.
description.zh: 将 Markdown、文件夹或 GitHub 学习仓库组织成课程，支持技能树、掌握程度跟踪和间隔复习。

description.en: Search PubMed, Europe PMC, arXiv and preprints, format citations and read open-access full text. Claim checks retrieve matching passages for manual review.
description.zh: 检索 PubMed、Europe PMC、arXiv 及预印本，生成引用并读取开放获取全文；引用核对基于词面匹配，需阅读原文确认。

description.en: ChatGPT-style message editing for DeepSeek Harness: edit a past prompt to rewind and branch the conversation, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse branches in a tree.
description.zh: 编辑历史提示词以回退和分支会话，并在树中浏览版本。

description.en: Mirror DSH sessions, messages and tool activity to a JARVIS Mission Control board, where finished turns wait for human review.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话、消息和工具活动同步到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，完成的回合交给人工审核。

description.en: Pair mobile devices and synchronize sessions and files over LAN or a Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 配对移动设备，同步会话与文件，支持局域网和 Cloudflare 隧道。

description.en: Route the pwsh tool to PowerShell 7 on Windows, with status, diagnostics and portable installation controls.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上把 pwsh 工具路由到 PowerShell 7，并提供状态、诊断和便携安装入口。

description.en: Creative branching canvas plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在树状创意画布中生成、对比和迭代多个可交互方案。

description.en: Exposes this machine's DSH web GUI to a chosen CIDR range, such as Tailscale, on DSH 0.2.1+. It can require an optional numeric access code and provides a phone layout that applies only to remote pages.
description.zh: 将网页界面开放给指定网段，可设置数字访问码，并为远程页面提供手机布局。

description.en: Discover DSH plugins on GitHub, inspect trust and compatibility evidence, and install through the official installer.
description.zh: 从 GitHub 发现 DSH 插件，检查可信度与兼容性证据，再通过官方安装器安装。

description.en: Review dependency advisories and static behavior evidence; automatic disabling requires a reviewed malicious finding.
description.zh: 检查依赖漏洞和插件行为证据，只有审核确认恶意行为后才自动停用插件。

description.en: Search session messages with Chinese-friendly substring matching, jump to highlighted results and move between matches.
description.zh: 按字词搜索会话正文，支持中文短词匹配、结果定位高亮和命中跳转。

description.en: Encode a plugin set as a share code or QR code that others can import and install item by item.
description.zh: 把插件组合生成分享码或二维码，供他人导入后逐项安装。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer, just above the account entry.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部、账户入口上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: General usage stats for DeepSeek Harness: throughput, tokens, cost, tool calls, and activity, charted in the Web UI. A TypeScript superset of dsh-plugin-tokspeed.
description.zh: 用图表展示吞吐量、Token、费用、工具调用和活跃情况，扩展自 dsh-plugin-tokspeed。

description.en: Subagent Director: choose an LLM provider/model for each subagent (call args > role binding > plugin default > inherit parent) and plan main-agent/subagent responsibilities with role templates, plus a settings UI.
description.zh: 为不同子 Agent 指定供应商、模型和角色模板，按调用参数或默认规则分配任务。

description.en: Mobile client for the DeepSeek Harness — use the dsh on your dev machine from your Android or iOS phone, remotely across networks, peer-to-peer over iroh with no server to set up (falls back to a relay that only sees ciphertext)
description.zh: 从 Android 或 iOS 手机远程使用电脑上的 DSH，支持点对点连接和中继转发。

description.en: One settings panel for MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and archived sessions, with custom scenarios that switch the whole setup at once. The agent can also operate this plugin.
description.zh: 在一个面板管理 MCP、技能、记忆、子 Agent、提示词和归档会话，并按场景整体切换配置。

description.en: Aggregate tokens and reference costs by time and model, with filters, cache statistics and configurable token prices.
description.zh: 按时间和模型汇总 Token 与参考成本，支持筛选、缓存统计和自定义 Token 单价。

description.en: Use local Wallpaper Engine scenes, web wallpapers and videos behind the DSH interface.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面使用本机 Wallpaper Engine 场景、网页与视频壁纸。

description.en: Weixin (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness: command a DSH agent from WeChat, with support for images, files, and voice-note transcription.
description.zh: 通过微信 iLink Bot 与 DSH 对话，支持图片、文件和语音转写。

description.en: Personal assistant plugin for deepseek-harness that organizes commitments from conversations, tracks plans across sessions, and delivers low-interruption reminders.
description.zh: 从会话整理承诺与计划，跨会话追踪并提供提醒。

description.en: Media models: standalone image and video model configuration, plus chat generation tools.
description.zh: 独立配置图片和视频模型，并在会话中调用生成工具。

description.en: Jizuo Video: standalone video projects, novel-adaptation scripts, and video editing.
description.zh: 即作视频：独立视频项目、小说改编剧本与视频编辑。

description.en: Pair a phone with desktop DSH over LAN or a public connection to follow the same session.
description.zh: 通过局域网或公网将手机与电脑 DSH 配对，同步访问会话。

description.en: Pomodoro timer for the DSH right sidebar: 25-minute focus and 5-minute break cycles, timed on the host; the agent can read status and start or stop it via pomodoro_panel.
description.zh: 在侧栏使用 25 分钟专注、5 分钟休息的番茄钟，关闭面板仍会计时，Agent 可查看和控制。

description.en: Pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a full sidebar page with focus, short-break, and long-break cycles, plus a countdown pill beside the composer.
description.zh: 提供专注、短休息和长休息计时，在侧栏及输入框旁显示倒计时。

description.en: View artifacts in a sidebar or open the panel in a larger browser tab.
description.zh: 在侧栏查看产物，或将面板弹出为更大的浏览器标签页。

description.en: Connect Postiz over MCP to inspect channels and posting rules, manage drafts and publish immediately or on schedule.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 连接 Postiz，查询渠道与发帖规则、管理草稿，并立即或定时发布。

description.en: Recalculate energy loss, loss rates and meter totals, reporting arithmetic differences against declared figures.
description.zh: 重算线损电量、线损率和计量点合计，提示与填报数值的算术差异。

description.en: Turn material into an HTML slideshow, an editable PPTX and a project file, with charts, light editing, undo and quality checks. Final PPTX rendering can use LibreOffice.
description.zh: 把材料做成 HTML 放映稿、可编辑的 PPTX 和工程文件，支持图表、轻量编辑、撤销与质量检查。最终 PPTX 渲染可选用 LibreOffice。

description.en: Create, edit, inspect and export presentations, reverse existing decks and use bundled design systems and templates.
description.zh: 创建、编辑、检查和导出 PPT，也可解析已有演示文稿，复用其结构与设计模板。

description.en: Preset editing, prompt injection, and DeepSeek adapter configuration.
description.zh: 预设编辑、提示词注入与 DeepSeek 适配器配置。

description.en: Guide the agent to clarify requirements with an explained questionnaire before execution; this is a prompt-based workflow.
description.zh: 引导 Agent 执行前用带逐题说明的问卷确认需求，通过提示词约束流程。

description.en: Edit personas, prompt sections and tool descriptions per preset, select tools and skills, and import or export JSON/YAML.
description.zh: 逐预设编辑人设、提示词段和工具描述，选择工具与技能，并导入导出 JSON 或 YAML。

description.en: Layered memory that captures conversations, extracts facts, consolidates scenes and distills a profile, then recalls what is relevant before each model step. The pipeline is adapted from TencentDB Agent Memory.
description.zh: 分层蒸馏记忆：自动记录对话、抽取原子记忆、整合场景并提炼画像，在每次模型调用前召回相关内容。管线设计移植自 TencentDB Agent Memory。

description.en: Analyze the workspace, explain its architecture, keep decisions and TODOs, and restore project context in later sessions, with optional hybrid retrieval.
description.zh: 分析当前工作区、讲解项目架构、保存开发决策和待办，并在后续会话中恢复项目上下文，可选混合检索。

description.en: Explain the consequences of extra-permission requests in full-access mode, with confidence and inspection scope.
description.zh: 在完全权限下分析额外授权请求的影响，并标注置信度与已检查范围。

description.en: Manage preset and custom prompt templates and insert them into the composer.
description.zh: 管理预设和自定义模板，一键插入当前输入框。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each reply and shows it as gray ghost text in the composer: Tab accepts, Alt+→ accepts piece by piece, ↻ suggests another and Esc dismisses. Uses the session model by default and sends only recent conversation text.
description.zh: 每轮回复结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色提示文字显示在输入框中：Tab 采纳、Alt+→ 逐段采纳、↻ 换一条、Esc 忽略。默认使用当前会话的模型，只发送最近的对话文本。

description.en: Translate supported DSH prompts, edit them per profile and inspect exact-version matching while retaining tool and parameter names.
description.zh: 按当前配置翻译和编辑 DSH 提示词，检查版本匹配，并保留工具名与参数名。

description.en: Combine PTC coding mode, Cordis tools and preset-authoring skills in switchable agent presets.
description.zh: 把 PTC 编码模式、Cordis 工具和预设编写技能组合为可切换的 Agent 预设。

description.en: A session-bound agent-native REPL for DeepSeek Harness PTC mode.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 PTC 模式提供与会话绑定的 REPL 交互执行环境。

description.en: Explore usage and estimated costs across sessions, including model trends, heatmaps, quotas, balance reconciliation and CSV export.
description.zh: 查看跨会话用量与费用估算，提供模型趋势、热力图、配额、余额对账和 CSV 导出。

description.en: Orchestrate local subagents with task dependencies, execution states, isolated sessions and stage checks.
description.zh: 在单机上编排子 Agent，管理任务依赖、执行状态、会话隔离和阶段检查。

description.en: dsh-qa QA Workbench: a local software testing workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Project/iteration dual-mode, full-flow requirements / test cases / defects / milestones / reports, native QA preset, settings, release history, kanban and calendar.
description.zh: 管理需求、测试用例、缺陷、里程碑、报告与版本记录。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: 10 testing skills (requirement analysis, test strategy, case writing/review, E2E/API automation, exploratory, regression, bug analysis) + shared core knowledge base — a full QA pipeline as agent skills.
description.zh: 提供需求分析、测试策略、用例、自动化、探索与回归测试技能。

description.en: Connect domestic and international Qoder model services to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 Qoder 国内与国际模型服务。

description.en: QQ Mail for the DSH right sidebar: read recent mail and send plain text with a confirm gate. Credentials are read only from a private secret.json.
description.zh: 在右侧栏读取 QQ 邮件、查看正文，并在确认后发送纯文本邮件；凭据从私有配置文件读取。

description.en: Turn conversation Markdown headings into a searchable outline with previews and navigation.
description.zh: 把会话中的 Markdown 标题整理为可搜索大纲，支持预览与跳转。

description.en: Moves the in-car radio from godot_citys into the DSH right sidebar: a three.js in-car view, winding night roads, and radio-browser internet stations (City Pop).
description.zh: 将 godot_citys 中的车载电台搬进 DSH 右侧栏：three.js 车内视角、蜿蜒的夜路，以及 radio-browser 网络电台（City Pop）。

description.en: Install a pinned rea-agents release locally, start its MCP service and upgrade through an update control.
description.zh: 在本地安装指定版本的 rea-agents、启动其 MCP 服务，并通过更新入口升级。

description.en: Read webpages and feeds with encoding detection, pagination and compact text output.
description.zh: 识别编码并读取网页与订阅源，处理分页，输出精简正文。

description.en: Restore the conversation and workspace before a sent message, then edit and resend it.
description.zh: 将会话和工作区恢复到消息发送前，再编辑并重发消息。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: recall sent-but-unread text messages before the model reads them.
description.zh: 在模型读取前撤回已发送但尚未处理的文字消息。

description.en: Search and recommend plugins using a public scoring model and a settings-page ranking.
description.zh: 按公开评分模型检索和推荐插件，并在设置页展示排行。

description.en: Media library for the dsh web UI: browse configured local directories as a grid or list, open images in a viewer, and play videos in a page-fullscreen player with swipe navigation.
description.zh: 以网格或列表浏览本地媒体目录，查看图片，或全屏播放和滑动切换视频。

description.en: References files, sessions, commands, skills, and historical external AI chats from the DSH @ menu.
description.zh: 通过 @ 菜单引用文件、会话、命令、技能，以及其他 AI 工具中的历史对话。

description.en: Connect remote SSH workspaces with file operations, mirror sync, deployment and port forwarding.
description.zh: 连接 SSH 远程工作区，使用文件操作、镜像同步、部署与端口转发。

description.en: Remote development launcher: install dsh on a remote host and use it in your local browser, with credentials staying on this machine.
description.zh: 在远程主机安装 DSH，通过本机浏览器访问，登录凭据保留在本机。

description.en: Provide remote access, QR sign-in and connection management over LAN or Tailscale.
description.zh: 通过局域网或 Tailscale 提供远程访问、扫码登录与连接管理。

description.en: Access sessions, approvals and files from mobile clients through a token gateway, with server switching and offline chat caching.
description.zh: 通过令牌网关从移动客户端访问会话、审批和文件，支持服务器切换及聊天离线缓存。

description.en: Checks repair-order settlement arithmetic: confirms that project amounts, parts and labor hours, and the settlement total are internally consistent; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: 核对维修工单中的项目金额、配件、工时和结算总额，仅提示算术差异。

description.en: Bind research claims to snapshots and export versioned reports with verification records.
description.zh: 将研究结论绑定到快照，导出带核验记录的版本化报告。

description.en: Restart the Windows desktop app through a detached helper, with confirmation, delay and executable path settings.
description.zh: 通过独立助手重启 Windows 桌面端，可设置确认、延时和目标程序路径。

description.en: Review a change set as a relationship graph in the middle column, with every node clickable to the exact source line.
description.zh: 用关系图审阅代码改动，点击节点即可跳转到相应源码行。

description.en: Rewind a conversation in place to any earlier user message and optionally restore the files the agent changed, without creating a branch.
description.zh: 在原窗口内把对话回退到任意更早的用户消息，可同时还原 Agent 改过的文件，不新建分支。

description.en: Per-request tier routing on the Laya judge, plus an Auto tier chip in the composer
description.zh: 通过 Laya 判断每次请求适合的模型档位，并在输入框显示自动选择结果。

description.en: RSS reader for the DSH right sidebar: feeds are set in config, entries sorted by time, with mark read and favorite; the host fetches via the local proxy.
description.zh: 在侧栏按时间阅读 RSS，标记已读或收藏，由宿主经本地代理获取订阅内容。

description.en: Turn explicit DSH session experience into reviewable native Skills.
description.zh: 将明确的 DSH 会话经验转化为可审查的原生技能。

description.en: Organize sourced company and job research, verify registered entities and generate evidence-bounded reports and interview questions.
description.zh: 整理公司与岗位的调查资料，核验登记主体，在证据支持的范围内生成报告、核对清单和面试问题。

description.en: Inspect injection patterns, redaction rules and local configuration, and produce risk reports.
description.zh: 检查提示注入模式、脱敏规则与本机配置，并输出风险报告。

description.en: Attach selected conversation text to the next message as editable annotations, retaining source highlights and jump-back links.
description.zh: 把对话中的选中文字作为可编辑批注附到下一条消息，保留原文高亮和回跳入口。

description.en: Balance monitor for third-party services in DeepSeek Harness: enter an API key and check remaining quota every 1 to 30 minutes, with a dashboard and sidebar status icon. Supports Tavily, Bocha, Firecrawl, SerpAPI, SearchApi, ScrapingBee, ScraperAPI, and TinyFish.
description.zh: 定时查询 Tavily、博查、Firecrawl、TinyFish 等服务的剩余额度，提供看板和侧栏状态图标。

description.en: Manage services and routes through a web console, with Cloudflare tunnels and password login.
description.zh: 通过网页控制台管理服务和路由，支持 Cloudflare 隧道与口令登录。

description.en: Injects a small continuity pointer when a new session starts; if there is no handoff document, it prefers reusing the previous session's compaction summary.
description.zh: 在新会话中注入简短的交接提示，没有交接文档时优先使用上一会话的压缩摘要。

description.en: Move, archive and tag sessions in batches, and manage workspace visibility and preset migration.
description.zh: 批量移动、归档和标记会话，管理工作区显示与预设迁移。

description.en: Extend session menus with unread status, information copying, IDE opening and deletion, plus status indicators and configurable actions.
description.zh: 扩展会话菜单的未读、信息复制、IDE 打开和删除操作，并提供状态点与动作开关。

description.en: Exchange coordination messages between independently started sessions in one workspace and flag potential write-scope conflicts.
description.zh: 让同一工作区内独立启动的会话互发协调消息，并提示可能的文件写入范围冲突。

description.en: Cross-device sync for DeepSeek Harness sessions: a dedicated git mirror of the session store, append-only three-way merge with keep-both + fork conflict resolution, /sync command, sync_pull/sync_push/sync_status tools, and configurable auto push/pull
description.zh: 通过独立 Git 镜像同步会话，并处理合并与分支冲突。

description.en: Automatically manages dsh session titles in a date｜type｜topic format, with a model summarizing the type and topic of the whole conversation.
description.zh: 由模型概括会话主题，按“日期｜类型｜主题”格式自动命名。

description.en: Search session history, recall cited content and organize conversation views.
description.zh: 全文检索历史会话、引用召回内容，并管理会话视图。

description.en: Archive, restore, delete or move sessions between workspaces from one panel.
description.zh: 在统一面板归档、恢复、删除或跨工作区移动会话。

description.en: Centrally manages environment variables injected into the host, with allowlisted hot reload for plugins that read them only at startup (such as dsh-sql).
description.zh: 集中管理宿主环境变量，对允许的插件热重载，使其读取更新后的值。

description.en: Share one or several Q&A rounds as PNG images, Markdown or HTML, with adjustable width, font size and whether to show the process.
description.zh: 把单轮或多轮问答导出为 PNG 图片、Markdown 或 HTML 分享，可调整宽度、字号以及是否显示过程。

description.en: Share persistent Bash sessions across agents in a DSH profile, preserving directories, variables and jobs. Requires Bash; commands run with the host user's permissions.
description.zh: 让同一 DSH profile 中的各个 Agent 共用持久 Bash 会话，保留目录、变量和作业。需要 Bash，命令以宿主用户权限运行。

description.en: Create images and videos through ComfyUI-backed tools and a conversation-linked canvas.
description.zh: 通过 ComfyUI 工具与关联会话的画布制作图片和视频。

description.en: Create local delivery reports from Git changes, test evidence and responsive interface checks.
description.zh: 根据 Git 变更、测试证据和响应式界面检查生成本地交付报告。

description.en: Side Chat Plus lets you select conversation text and ask about it in a per-session side chat. It is a hidden session with its own right panel that inherits model, effort, and permissions.
description.zh: 选中文字后在独立侧边会话中追问，沿用主会话的模型、思考强度和权限。

description.en: Lets the agent drive DSH's built-in browser in the right sidebar's Browser tab: list tabs, open and navigate pages, read content, run JavaScript, click, fill forms, and log in.
description.zh: 让 Agent 操作 DSH 内置浏览器，管理标签页、读取网页、运行 JavaScript、点击和填写表单。

description.en: Mark DSH sidebar conversations with a tinted background, a colored dot at the row's end, and a per-conversation title size.
description.zh: 为侧栏会话设置背景色、彩色标记和标题字号。

description.en: DSH web plugin: select conversation text -> ask in a right-side panel -> a dedicated follow-up session (❓<topic>) in the same workspace, without interrupting the main conversation. Runs on DSH's own right sidebar, with no extra dependencies.
description.zh: 选择对话文字，在同一工作区的独立会话中继续追问。

description.en: DSH inline follow-up questions answered in a side card: select text in chat or task areas to ask in place, with a separate subagent streaming the answer, optionally sent back to the main conversation.
description.zh: 选中文字后在侧边卡片中追问，由独立子 Agent 流式回答，结果可发回主对话。

description.en: Open side conversations and annotate selected text beside the main chat.
description.zh: 在主对话旁打开侧边聊天，并为选中文字添加批注。

description.en: Browse and search local skills, read SKILL.md and record tool outcomes in a skill-failure ledger.
description.zh: 浏览、搜索和阅读本地技能，记录调用结果及失败情况，方便后续排查。

description.en: Browse and toggle skills, diagnose metadata problems, and import or track updates from repositories.
description.zh: 在设置页浏览和开关技能，检查格式问题，并从仓库导入及跟踪更新。

description.en: dsh-skill-mcp-panel: manage skills and MCP servers from the DSH web sidebar plus the unified dsh-panel CLI.
description.zh: 通过网页侧栏与命令行统一管理技能和 MCP 服务器。

description.en: DSH Web GUI skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official `/skill-name` gesture into the input box, so the skill loads with your message (WorkBuddy-style skill invocation for DeepSeek Harness).
description.zh: 搜索已安装技能，并将官方技能调用指令插入输入框。

description.en: Discover skills from local directories and Git sources for on-demand loading through DSH or local MCP.
description.zh: 汇总本地与 Git 来源的技能，供 DSH 或本地 MCP 按需加载。

description.en: Native skin marketplace and lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 浏览和管理 DSH 原生主题皮肤。

description.en: Local filesystem slash-command provider for the DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 从本地文件加载和使用斜杠命令。

description.en: Give the agent a make_slides tool that writes a self-contained HTML deck with speaker notes, which presents offline and prints to PDF, plus an optional editable PPTX.
description.zh: 提供 make_slides 工具，生成可离线放映、带演讲备注并可打印为 PDF 的单文件 HTML 演示稿，也可导出可编辑的 PPTX。

description.en: Add a smoothly moving comet cursor to the chat composer with configurable trails, colors, and thickness.
description.zh: 为聊天输入框添加平滑移动的彗星光标，可调整拖尾、颜色与粗细。

description.en: Fluid streaming rendering and silky scrolling for DeepSeek Harness replies, including Markdown, code blocks, tables, and tool results.
description.zh: 调整 Markdown、代码、表格与工具结果的流式渲染和滚动。

description.en: Checks 三重一大 decision ledgers against prior research, meeting deliberation and resolution records; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: 依据前置研究、会议审议与决议记录程序，核对“三重一大”决策台账并留痕；仅提示差异，不作定性结论。

description.en: Personalization settings for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加个性化设置。

description.en: Browse commit graphs and diffs, stage or discard changes, amend commits and create repositories or pull requests through gh.
description.zh: 查看 Git 提交图和差异，暂存或丢弃改动、修改上次提交，并通过 gh 创建仓库或拉取请求。

description.en: Split the conversation area into native panes (side by side, stacked, 2×2 or auto grid), each an independent session. Layout is remembered. Desktop profile.
description.zh: 把对话区拆成原生窗格（左右、上下、2×2 或自动网格），每个窗格是独立会话，布局会被记住。适用于桌面版。

description.en: Drive remote servers from the conversation: interactive terminal, SFTP file management, port forwarding and database management.
description.zh: 在会话中操作远程服务器，使用终端、SFTP 文件管理、端口转发和数据库工具。

description.en: DSH plugin: SSH remote ops and dev toolkit (run/read/write/edit/glob/grep/push/pull), ControlMaster connection layer, status panel, and host management in Settings.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 执行远程命令和文件读写、搜索、传输，在设置中管理主机与连接状态。

description.en: Multi-host SSH tunnel and SSHManager tool for DeepSeek Harness, with project-scoped grants.
description.zh: 管理多台主机的 SSH 隧道，并按项目授予连接权限。

description.en: DSH startup animation and background plugin: plays a local video full-screen at launch without blocking startup, plus a persistent background video layer with adjustable opacity and playback controls.
description.zh: 启动时播放本地全屏视频，也可设置常驻动态背景，调整透明度和播放方式。

description.en: Turn the DSH Web status line into a 1317-phrase meme machine: phase-aware phrases, typewriter, rainbow gradient, danmaku and 14 theme packs, all editable from the settings page.
description.zh: 按运行阶段显示可编辑文案、主题与状态栏动画。

description.en: Keep current reasoning visible and fold older thinking and tool output into compact summaries.
description.zh: 展示当前思考，将较早的思考与工具输出折叠为简短摘要。

description.en: Show account quota, subscription type and daily statistics in the session header, with refresh and error notices.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏显示账号额度、订阅类型与今日统计，支持刷新和异常提示。

description.en: Sets default models for DSH subagents, with sequential or random assignment across models and cross-vendor failover on connection errors. Shows the current vendor and model in trajectory and conversation views.
description.zh: 为子 Agent 分配默认模型，支持顺序或随机选择，以及连接失败时切换供应商。

description.en: Groups the built-in subagent dropdown by usage batch into History, Today, Previous and Current. The current batch stays expanded and the others can be collapsed; the original header is left untouched.
description.zh: 把原生「子代理」下拉按使用批次分为历史、今日、上次、本次四组，本次始终展开，其余可折叠；不改动原有头部。

description.en: Unified subscription providers and usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一订阅供应商与用量看板。

description.en: Show clickable follow-up suggestions below replies and send a selected suggestion as a user message.
description.zh: 在回复下方显示可点击的后续建议，选中后作为用户消息发送。

description.en: Adds input prediction to the DSH composer: suggests your next message after each turn (Tab to accept), and completes prefixes from session history as you type.
description.zh: 在每轮结束后建议下一条消息，支持 Tab 采纳，并根据会话历史补全输入。

description.en: Register Superpowers development skills and session guidance with the DSH skills and prompt services.
description.zh: 接入 Superpowers 开发技能，并向会话提示词添加使用引导。

description.en: Route tasks among model pools and manage context thresholds, delegation, forked backups and handoff documents.
description.zh: 在多个模型池之间派发任务，管理上下文阈值、委派、分叉备份和交接文档。

description.en: Lay out the sessions, follow-ups and forks of a workspace as a draggable, zoomable map, keeping native DSH sessions as the only source of truth.
description.zh: 把同一工作区的会话、追问和分支排成可拖拽、可缩放的地图，DSH 原生会话仍是唯一的数据来源。

description.en: Provide typed yes/no decisions, classifications and scores through System One services and agent tools.
description.zh: 通过 System One 服务和 Agent 工具进行是非判断、分类与评分，返回类型明确的结果。

description.en: Tabbit Browser bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a code-first tabbit_browser tool, browser-backed web_fetch, @tab composer mentions, a dedicated page-access permission, an environment preflight with background installer download, and a daily plugin update check.
description.zh: 操作 Tabbit 标签页，抓取网页，并在输入框引用浏览器内容。

description.en: Tailscale remote access operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: health checks, HTTPS ingress toggle, macOS proxy bypass, relay server operations, and ACL snippet generation.
description.zh: 在面板中检查和管理 Tailscale 远程访问、HTTPS 入口、代理、中继及访问控制规则。

description.en: Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that runs recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session.
description.zh: 根据任务表定时派发 Agent 任务，每次在独立 DSH 会话中执行。

description.en: A read-only board over task-ledger workspaces, with the task-ledger skill bundled for global use.
description.zh: 只读查看 task-ledger 工作区的任务看板，并附带可全局使用的 task-ledger 技能。

description.en: Let long-running scripts report structured progress that DSH Web shows in a floating panel and a sidebar tab, without waiting for the command to finish.
description.zh: 长时间运行的脚本可以上报结构化进度，在 DSH Web 的悬浮窗和右侧栏实时显示，不用等命令结束。

description.en: Track project tasks and run them in sessions with optional per-task Git worktrees.
description.zh: 跟踪项目任务并在会话中执行，可为任务配置独立 Git 工作树。

description.en: Manage character cards, worldbooks, presets, memory and plot options; some features require companion plugins.
description.zh: 管理角色卡、世界书、预设、记忆和剧情选项；部分功能需配套插件。

description.en: Checks tender-document clause excerpts against the original text, verifying completeness by source and verbatim wording; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: 依据出处与原文逐字核对招标文件条款摘录的完整性；仅提示差异，不作定性结论。

description.en: A DSH Web theme in the style of the Arknights: Endfield website: cream paper, ink text, signal-yellow accents and square corners, with optional animated backgrounds.
description.zh: 参考《明日方舟：终末地》官网风格的 DSH Web 主题：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、信号黄强调色和直角，可选动态背景。

description.en: Apply a Firefly character theme with wallpaper, colors and an opening animation.
description.zh: 应用流萤角色壁纸、主题配色与开场动画。

description.en: Mineradio: a cinematic private-visual-radio glass theme for the Web surface — champagne glow, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, unified corners, and motion
description.zh: 为网页界面添加电台风格配色、玻璃表面、壁纸与动效。

description.en: Native token-based themes for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with custom colors and system font pickers.
description.zh: 通过界面配色变量应用原生主题，可选择自定义颜色和系统字体。

description.en: Escape from Tarkov themed plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a hero beta-warning banner, translucent looping video background, background music dock, and event sound effects.
description.zh: 应用《逃离塔科夫》主题，提供视频背景、背景音乐和事件提示音。

description.en: Display-layer translation for the DSH web app: thinking chain, task cards, and optional answer text, in 8 target languages (local Ollama / any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic endpoint / Google / Bing, fail-open)
description.zh: 在显示层翻译思考、任务卡片及可选的回答文字。

description.en: Adjust reasoning effort automatically for each tool round, with an optional manual lock and per-tool timing.
description.zh: 按每轮工具调用自动调整推理强度，也可以手动锁定档位，并记录各工具的耗时。

description.en: Turn the current session into an editable thought graph on an infinite canvas.
description.zh: 将当前会话整理为无限画布上的可编辑思维图。

description.en: Turn TiddlyWiki 5 into a local, plain-text knowledge base under Git that you and the agent read and write together. It is not an automatic memory plugin; publishing to WeChat Official Account drafts is optional.
description.zh: 把 TiddlyWiki 5 变成你和 Agent 共用的本地知识库，纯文本并用 Git 管理。不在后台自动记忆，可选发布到微信公众号草稿箱。

description.en: Connect native web search and fetch tools to TinyFish through direct or Monid access.
description.zh: 为网页搜索与抓取接入 TinyFish，支持直连或 Monid 通道。

description.en: TinyFish-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web). Seamlessly routes model web searches to the fast and privacy-friendly TinyFish Search API.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置网页搜索接入 TinyFish Search API。

description.en: A persistent tmux control-mode panel in DSH Web that attaches to existing tmux sessions, stays visible across chats and adapts to phones.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中常驻的 tmux 控制模式工作台，连接已有的 tmux 会话，切换聊天时保持可见，并适配手机。

description.en: Lightweight to-do list for the DSH right sidebar: one item per line, check off to complete, collapsible completed items; stored locally, and the agent can add, check and delete via todo_panel.
description.zh: 在侧栏逐项管理待办，勾选完成、折叠已完成项，支持 Agent 添加和修改。

description.en: DSH todo floating ball: a draggable widget showing live progress of the session's todo_write list (total, done, in progress), with click to expand and status colours. Works on desktop and web.
description.zh: 用可拖动悬浮球显示待办总数、完成数和进行中任务，点击可展开清单。

description.en: Manage projects, labels, priorities and recurring tasks, with natural-language capture, statistics, import/export and agent tools.
description.zh: 管理项目、标签、优先级和重复任务，支持自然语言添加、统计、导入导出及 Agent 工具。

description.en: Deterministic, recoverable tool-result compression and cache-aware compaction for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 压缩工具输出并保留恢复能力，结合缓存状态压缩上下文。

description.en: A bilingual floating pet for DeepSeek Harness with runtime status, context and lifetime token usage, trends, and optional completion sounds.
description.zh: 用浮动角色展示运行状态、上下文与累计 Token 用量。

description.en: Organize media projects and assets, then run TongFlow image, voice, music and video workflows on an embedded canvas.
description.zh: 按项目整理媒体素材，在内嵌画布中运行 TongFlow 图片、配音、音乐和视频流程。

description.en: Load only basic DeepSeek Harness tools by default and activate other tools on demand.
description.zh: 默认仅加载基础 DeepSeek Harness 工具，其他工具按需激活。

description.en: Serves web_search and web_fetch from switchable backends such as Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and TinyFish, chosen per conversation from the composer. Installs the enhanced search and fetch plugins together; remove their standalone 0.1.x versions first.
description.zh: 用可切换的后端（Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、TinyFish 等）提供 web_search 与 web_fetch，每个会话在输入框中选择连接。会一并安装增强搜索与抓取插件，安装前需先移除两者的 0.1.x 独立版本。

description.en: Responsive MCP management UI and skills manager for DeepSeek Harness Web — floating panel, JSON import, profile-backed Host Remote management, and a skill market with a hard license gate.
description.zh: 在浮动面板中管理 MCP 和技能，导入配置，并浏览带许可证检查的技能市场。

description.en: Plan multi-agent tasks in isolated worktrees and merge results through review gates.
description.zh: 安排多个 Agent 在独立 Git 工作树中执行任务，经审查确认后合并结果。

description.en: Start a local TensorBoard scalar dashboard from a DSH tool: pick primary and secondary metrics, set the improvement direction and optional EMA smoothing for existing training logs. Read-only; requires Python 3.10+ and TensorBoard.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 工具启动本地 TensorBoard 标量监控页，可选主要和辅助指标、改善方向与 EMA 平滑，查看已有训练日志。只读取日志，需要 Python 3.10+ 和 TensorBoard。

description.en: Browse, switch and rename conversation branches, or turn a branch into an independent session.
description.zh: 用树形视图浏览、切换和重命名会话分支，也可将分支转为独立会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin wrapper that registers the domestic trip-planner-cn Agent Skill in the DSH skill catalog, so after installation you can load SKILL.md and its references, scripts, and themes resources by name.
description.zh: 将 trip-planner-cn 旅行规划技能注册到 DSH，按名称加载技能及其参考资料和脚本。

description.en: DSH plugin: delete an archived session's local files (transcript, projection cache and its subagent sessions) after a two-step confirmation.
description.zh: 经两步确认后，删除已归档会话的本地记录、缓存及关联子 Agent 会话。

description.en: List installed plugins' capabilities, prompt injections and install scripts with source locations.
description.zh: 列出已装插件的能力、提示词注入和安装脚本，并提供源码位置。

description.en: Expose a running tsm-core-dlr vector-and-graph service as MCP tools, with modeling skills and a service-status panel.
description.zh: 把运行中的 tsm-core-dlr 向量与图服务接为 MCP 工具，提供建模技能和服务状态面板。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that shows the CNY cost of each completed turn. It uses per-model cache-hit/miss, cache-write, and output rates, with weekly peak-valley multipliers and promos.
description.zh: 按模型价格估算每轮人民币费用，区分缓存命中、写入和输出，并考虑峰谷价及促销。

description.en: Appearance customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, background image, transparency and blur over the --dsw-* token system
description.zh: 调整主题配色、背景图片、透明度与模糊。

description.en: DeepSeek design specification: unifies the Harness interface language, with targeted adaptation for community plugins and a read-only compatibility audit.
description.zh: 统一 DSH 的界面样式，适配社区插件，并提供只读兼容性检查。

description.en: Adjust code typography, layout, branch indicators and conversation helpers from settings.
description.zh: 在设置面板调整代码字号、布局、分支显示与会话辅助功能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness custom wallpaper plugin: pick a local image as background in the Settings panel, adjust opacity, blur, UI transparency and dimming, with instant preview.
description.zh: 选择本地图片作为壁纸，调整透明度、模糊和明暗，并即时预览。

description.en: DSH undo/rollback system: snapshot config files on change, undo/redo the last action from the WebUI or by chat, and roll back broken plugin trees without reinstalling. Works even when DSH fails to boot (offline CLI + GUI).
description.zh: 为配置变更保存快照，支持撤销、重做和恢复损坏的插件配置；DSH 无法启动时也可离线恢复。

description.en: Create, edit and review spreadsheets, documents and slides in DSH, with Office import and export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内创建、编辑和审阅表格、文档与演示稿，支持 Office 导入导出。

description.en: Auto-check DeepSeek Harness updates for both dsh web and the Desktop app, check third-party plugin updates, notify in the GUI, one-click update with backup/rollback and restart watchdog.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 和第三方插件更新，提供备份、回滚与重启流程。

description.en: Per-turn token usage and cost estimates, a usage page by model and session, and a 52-week activity heatmap for DSH Web. Costs are estimates; community sharing is off by default.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 显示每轮 Token 用量和费用估算，按模型和会话查看统计，并提供 52 周活动热力图。费用为估算值，社区数据分享默认关闭。

description.en: Display the current model provider’s balance, subscription quotas, and reset times above the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示当前模型供应商的账户余额、套餐额度及重置时间。

description.en: Per-day token trend, activity heatmap, cache hit-rate curve, and per-model / per-provider breakdowns of session token usage.
description.zh: 展示每日 Token 趋势、活跃热力图、缓存命中率，以及各模型和供应商的用量。

description.en: Configure Gemini API and Vertex AI decoding, protocols and service tiers, and inspect responses, usage and estimated costs.
description.zh: 配置 Gemini API 与 Vertex AI 的解码、协议和服务等级，并检查响应、用量与费用估算。

description.en: Use structured agent presets for mathematical exploration, solving and verification.
description.zh: 通过多 Agent 预设进行数学探索、问题求解和形式化验证。

description.en: Route image questions to vision providers and expose OCR, grounding and pixel comparison tools.
description.zh: 将图片问题路由到视觉供应商，并提供 OCR、定位与像素比较工具。

description.en: Makes DSH speak when a job finishes: automatic voice alerts for done, failed and approval events, 20 built-in sounds with zero config, or clone your own voice.
description.zh: 在任务完成、失败或等待审批时语音提醒，提供内置音效，也可使用自己的音色。

description.en: Let agents offer voice calls; accept, reject or defer them, with local speech synthesis after acceptance.
description.zh: 让 Agent 发起语音来电，可接听、拒绝或稍后处理，接听后通过本地语音合成播放。

description.en: Provide streaming dictation, optional wake words, spoken replies, live captions and interruption when the user speaks.
description.zh: 提供流式听写、可选唤醒词、回复朗读与实时字幕，用户开口时可打断播放。

description.en: Transcribe speech with local SenseVoice or optional services, with hotwords and text polishing.
description.zh: 使用本机 SenseVoice 或可选语音服务转录输入，支持热词与文字润色。

description.en: Deploy DSH to a VPS over SSH and manage its HTTPS gateway, service state and upgrades.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把 DSH 部署到 VPS，并管理 HTTPS 网关、服务状态和升级。

description.en: Manage registered VPS hosts over SSH, with terminals, status commands, confirmation gates and file backups.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 管理已登记的 VPS，提供终端、状态命令、操作确认和文件备份。

description.en: Add a Monaco editor and review agent edits with per-change acceptance, rejection and rollback.
description.zh: 提供 Monaco 文件编辑器，逐处审查、采纳或拒绝 Agent 修改，并支持回滚。

description.en: Add file browsing, Monaco editing, search and local Git controls to DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供文件浏览、Monaco 编辑器、搜索和本地 Git 操作面板。

description.en: Sync active Wallpaper Engine wallpapers(image/video/scence/app)to DeepSeek Harness Web UI as a customizable dynamic background.
description.zh: 将当前 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸同步为可调整的网页背景。

description.en: A standalone DSH wallpaper background plugin with built-in wallpapers, custom uploads, and a read-only Wallpaper Engine library. That library needs the companion plugin dsh-wallpaper-engine-api.
description.zh: 设置内置或上传的壁纸，也可读取 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库，后者需安装配套插件。

description.en: Read-only DSH session insights and local model usage statistics
description.zh: 只读查看会话运行信息与本机模型用量统计。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API balance and this conversation's spend in the Harness web UI: a persistent balance pill beside the composer, with details on hover.
description.zh: 在输入框旁显示 DeepSeek API 余额与当前会话费用，悬停查看明细。

description.en: DSH Web Git Sidebar: VS Code-style left-rail Git panel for DeepSeek Harness with branch switching, commit graph, per-commit previews and a session-following footer entry.
description.zh: 在左侧 Git 面板中切换分支、查看提交图和每次提交的内容。

description.en: Browser tab favicon reflects DSH session state (idle, running, asking, done), recolored and animated in the browser from one base SVG, with fully configurable colors and effects.
