description.zh: 让浏览器标签页图标随会话状态变色或播放动画，可自定义颜色与效果。

description.en: LAN / remote access support for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: self-contained 0.0.0.0 binding, remote Host settings, automatic /api trust-fence widening, and an insecure-origin randomUUID polyfill.
description.zh: 为网页界面配置局域网绑定和远程宿主访问。

description.en: Adapt the web interface for portrait screens and mobile devices.
description.zh: 为竖屏和移动设备调整网页界面布局。

description.en: DSH web search provider chosen by vendor and protocol: Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages with built-in search tools, plus standalone search APIs.
description.zh: 为网页搜索选择供应商和接口协议，支持模型内置搜索及独立搜索 API。

description.en: Unified web search for the DeepSeek Harness seam (ctx.web): DeepSeek (official), Tavily, Brave, Serper, SerpApi, Exa, SearXNG, Scavio, and Firecrawl backends
description.zh: 统一接入 DeepSeek、Tavily、Brave、Exa、SearXNG、Firecrawl 等网页搜索服务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: an agent-safe EVM wallet with an encrypted vault, signing policy, model tools, a bundled skill, and a web UI.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供 EVM 钱包，支持加密存储、签名规则、操作工具和网页管理。

description.en: Use logged-in web AI services (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Doubao, etc.) as model providers in DeepSeek Harness. Web models emit tool calls, and DSH runs them under its native permission system.
description.zh: 将已登录的 DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen、豆包等网页服务接为模型，由 DSH 按权限规则执行工具调用。

description.en: Edit web plugin sources, preview changes and run patch checks and builds from a workbench.
description.zh: 在工作台编辑网页插件源码、预览改动，并运行补丁检查和构建。

description.en: Bridge WeChat (iLink bot) to DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 通过微信 iLink Bot 连接 DSH 会话。

description.en: Send WeCom group-bot messages for approvals, questions, completed tasks, blocked goals and errors.
description.zh: 通过企业微信群机器人提醒审批、提问、任务完成、目标阻塞和错误。

description.en: Show DeepSeek account balance as a whale-shaped water level, with spending history and low-balance reminders.
description.zh: 用鲸鱼水位显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，悬停查看消耗记录与低余额提醒。

description.en: Links pet-whale and dsh-whale-widget: when the desk pet nears the widget it pretends to work and turns toward it, and the widget greets it with a default bubble, without modifying either plugin's source.
description.zh: 连接桌宠与余额鲸鱼挂件，让两者靠近时触发转身、假装工作和气泡互动。

description.en: Whale-girl desktop pet for DSH web that mirrors session status, with zone hotspots, feeding, drag, emoji bubbles, a token/cost dashboard, XP and titles, and optional proactive companionship.
description.zh: 用鲸鱼娘桌宠反映会话状态，支持拖拽、喂食、气泡、用量面板和可关闭的主动陪伴。

description.en: A multi-character Galgame interface and optional desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 为网页会话添加多角色 Galgame 互动界面，感知其他会话的任务事件，并提供可选桌面伴侣。

description.en: Show session progress, token usage and costs through a whale-girl companion and task bubbles.
description.zh: 用角色状态与任务气泡展示会话进度、Token 用量和费用。

description.en: Show account balance and per-turn usage in a customizable animated whale widget.
description.zh: 用可自定义的鲸鱼挂件显示账户余额与每轮用量。

description.en: Arrange session statistics, tasks, context, heatmaps, references and quota widgets in a configurable sidebar grid.
description.zh: 在侧栏网格中自由排列会话统计、任务、上下文、热力图、引用和额度等组件。

description.en: Diagnose and fix DSH on native Windows without WSL: PowerShell, Workspace Write, shortcuts and legacy preset repair. Declares support only for DSH 0.1.
description.zh: 在原生 Windows 上诊断并修复 DSH，无需 WSL，涵盖 PowerShell、工作区写入、快捷方式和旧预设修复。仅声明支持 DSH 0.1。

description.en: DSH toolbox bundle: one plugin installs five features, each with its own switch: delete conversations, regenerate from here, the /teammate command, cross-session reminders, and auto-naming after the first turn. The plugin page shows one card with five component rows.
description.zh: 组合提供删除会话、重新生成、/teammate、跨会话提醒和自动命名，各项可独立开关。

description.en: Automatically connects models included in the WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: 自动接入本机 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中的模型。

description.en: Connect WorkBuddy desktop models through the Functy fork, with a dashboard, account rotation and quota display.
description.zh: 通过 Functy 分支接入 WorkBuddy 桌面模型，提供仪表盘、账号轮换和额度显示。

description.en: Show a live status line while the agent works: current phase, the tool actually running, elapsed time and a summary when the turn ends. Works in the TUI, Web UI and desktop app.
description.zh: Agent 工作时显示一行实时状态：当前阶段、正在运行的工具、已用时间和回合结束摘要，终端、网页和桌面端通用。

description.en: Worktree Space gives each task its own space across one or more Git repos, with a worktree per repo on one task branch. It merges back to each target branch and can hand conflicts to an agent.
description.zh: 为每个任务建立独立的 Git 工作树，支持跨仓库执行、合并回目标分支，并把冲突交给 Agent 处理。

description.en: DSH Desktop WSL execution environment: add a WSL workspace and run every tool inside the distribution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端添加 WSL 工作区，让工具在指定发行版中执行。

description.en: Run a session's shell and file tools inside a selected WSL distribution.
description.zh: 在选定的 WSL 发行版中运行会话命令与文件工具。

description.en: Aggregate accounts and provider models, inspect usage, and configure routing and a local gateway.
description.zh: 汇总多个账号和供应商的模型，查看用量、设置路由，并提供本机模型网关。

description.en: Read replies with Xiaomi MiMo TTS or the browser's local speech engine.
description.zh: 使用 Xiaomi MiMo TTS 或浏览器本地语音朗读回复。

description.en: Use models from a Zed AI subscription through Zed Cloud and configure their credentials in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 Zed Cloud 使用 Zed AI 订阅提供的模型，并在 DSH 中配置凭据。

description.en: Provide a mobile interface and pairing gateway, with installable PWA and push notifications through your proxy or tunnel.
description.zh: 通过手机或其他电脑远程访问 DSH，支持配对、PWA 和推送通知，需自行配置代理或隧道。

description.en: Zhihu site search, global web search, and Zhida answers for the model, via the official Zhihu Open Platform API.
description.zh: 为模型提供知乎站内搜索、全网搜索与知乎直答，基于知乎开放平台官方 API。

description.en: Search a local Zotero library, read notes and annotations, extract evidence, and generate citations.
description.zh: 检索本地 Zotero 文献库，读取笔记和标注，提取证据并生成引用。

description.en: Browse community plugins and manage installations from a visual market inside DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内浏览社区插件，并通过可视化市场管理安装。

description.en: Connect FitMeet through per-user OAuth for people, activities, reminders, messages and previewed writes.
description.zh: 通过各用户独立的 OAuth 授权接入 FitMeet，查找人员、管理活动、提醒和消息，并在写入前预览。

description.en: Check and revise Chinese official documents with formatting rules and templates.
description.zh: 使用格式规则和模板检查、修订中文公文。

description.en: Agent toolkit that helps coding agents use Huawei Cloud Skills, KooCLI, APIs, SDKs, and future MCP capabilities safely and accurately.
description.zh: 在编程会话中使用华为云技能、KooCLI、API 与 SDK。

description.en: A local workspace for content creators that carries ideas, scripts, production, publishing and reviews, keeping each piece as an ordinary folder. Built for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 面向内容创作者的本地工作台，从灵感、脚本到制作、发布和复盘集中推进，每条内容都是普通文件夹。适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Add project memory, task planning and verification to DSH, plus AgenticReplay to record and export model and tool activity.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加项目记忆、任务规划和验证支持，并可用 AgenticReplay 记录、导出模型和工具活动。

description.en: Image bridge: connects external image-generation models to models without image generation or editing abilities. Configure the API and key in the web interface, and the model can call image generation and editing directly.
description.zh: 生图桥：给没有生图/修图能力的模型接入外部生图模型。在 Web 界面配置 API 与 Key，模型即可直接调用生图/改图能力。

description.en: Lunheng is a DeepSeek Harness skill pack for multi-agent long-form articles. It runs research, a human-confirmed outline, writing, critique, audit, review, revision, and delivery across nine roles.
description.zh: 由九种角色分工完成长文检索、大纲确认、写作、评审、修改和交付。

description.en: Store conversation knowledge cards in a local Markdown vault and recall them on demand.
description.zh: 将会话提炼为知识卡，保存在本地 Markdown 或 SQLite 中，支持检索、知识图谱和审核。

description.en: Inspect token costs, cache-hit breakdowns and cumulative spending curves.
description.zh: 查看 Token 费用、缓存命中明细与累计花费曲线。

description.en: Cross-session project memory for DeepSeek Harness: seven-layer SQLite memory, first-turn snapshot injection, per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/project tools, automatic reflection with reflection-fold UI, and idle-triggered dream consolidation (peak-hour suppressed).
description.zh: 通过 SQLite 分层记忆、检索工具与自动反思保存项目知识。

description.en: Collapse the idle composer and automatically close the sidebar on narrow screens.
description.zh: 收起闲置输入框，并在窄屏选中会话后自动关闭侧栏。

description.en: Develop Minecraft server plugins and mods with version-aware skills and a Gradle runner.
description.zh: 使用区分版本的技能与 Gradle 工具开发 Minecraft 插件和模组。

description.en: Search evidence-rated failure lessons through the public MisakaNet MCP service.
description.zh: 通过 MisakaNet 公共 MCP 服务，检索附有证据评级的失败案例和经验。

description.en: Newmark Core for DeepSeek Harness: MemoryLab, ComputerUse, Agent API, NewMate companion core, and heartBeat restart delivery, with five independent toggles sharing the ~/.Newmark user library.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Newmark 核心：包括 MemoryLab、ComputerUse、Agent API、NewMate 陪伴内核与 heartBeat 重启投递，提供五个独立开关，共用 ~/.Newmark 用户库。

description.en: Connect TokenDance through OAuth, control catalog visibility and expose chat, media generation and typed decision tools.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 接入 TokenDance，设置可见模型，提供对话、媒体生成和返回明确格式的判断工具。

description.en: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin for DeepSeek Harness on Chrome and Edge
description.zh: 在 Chrome 或 Edge 中为 DSH 网页渲染实时海洋背景。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle: optimize raw instructions into professional Role / Task / Context / Format prompts through the harness llm service
description.zh: 通过当前模型将原始指令整理为角色、任务、上下文与格式。

description.en: Run unmodified Pi extensions as native DSH plugins, with compatibility checks and translation of Pi MCP settings.
description.zh: 让 Pi 扩展不经修改就作为 DSH 原生插件运行，并提供兼容性检查和 Pi MCP 配置转换。

description.en: PRTS.chat corpus browser with local/cloud search, source reading and a Rhine Lab 3D workspace for deepseek-harness
description.zh: 检索和阅读 PRTS.chat 语料，并在莱茵生命主题的三维工作区中整理资料。

description.en: Define specialist agent roles in YAML, each with its own prompt, model, skills and permissions, run them together as multi-agent graphs, and keep what they learn across sessions. Also works with OpenCode, Pi and Codex.
description.zh: 用 YAML 定义专职 Agent 角色，各自配置提示词、模型、技能和权限，按多 Agent 流程协作，并跨会话保留经验。也支持 OpenCode、Pi 和 Codex。

description.en: An open optimization framework that iteratively improves an agent's model, instructions, tools and workflow against a benchmark you provide.
description.zh: 开源优化框架，根据你提供的基准任务迭代改进 Agent 的模型、指令、工具和工作流程。

description.en: Keep cross-session memories in local Markdown files and retrieve relevant content for context injection.
description.zh: 将跨会话记忆保存为本地 Markdown 文件，按问题检索并注入相关内容。

description.en: Local image-code knowledge library with native macOS and local Web clients, plus MCP and Skill for Pi, DeepSeek Harness (dsh), Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Wisp.
description.zh: 在本机管理和检索科研图片及代码，通过客户端、MCP 或技能供编程助手调用。

description.en: Multi-engine web search for coding agents — one SearchBoost core (fused search, fetch, X) with MCP (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, Antigravity), pi extension, and DeepSeek Harness bundle adapters
description.zh: 融合多引擎搜索、网页抓取与 X 检索，并提供 DSH 适配器。

description.en: A terminal workspace for DSH: run deepseek in a project to use Harness agents, sessions, models and plugins from the terminal. Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: DSH 的终端工作台，在项目目录运行 deepseek，即可在终端里使用 Harness 的 Agent、会话、模型和插件。已在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上测试。

description.en: Superpowers for the DeepSeek Harness: TDD, debugging, planning, and collaboration skills adapted from obra/superpowers
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入测试驱动开发、调试、规划与协作技能。

description.en: Weir: an orchestrator-centric DSH agent preset with an intent gate, category delegation, a todo driver, pull-based background jobs, auto-compaction, and hashline editing.
description.zh: 提供 Weir Agent 预设，统筹任务确认、分类委派、待办执行、后台任务和上下文压缩。

description.en: Add an interactive companion character to the DSH web interface.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面添加可互动的角色伙伴。

description.en: Control Windows apps through window targets, UI Automation, screenshots and verified input, with an isolated Chromium option.
description.zh: 通过窗口定位、UI Automation、截图和输入检查操作 Windows 应用，可使用独立 Chromium 实例。

description.en: Exposes DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web capabilities to the Xiaozhi voice assistant over MCP, as a self-contained bundle that registers DSH as an MCP tool provider and supports multiple devices.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DSH 工具接给小智语音助手，支持多个设备。
